/info/description.en:
Every Scacelith server, the official `caissa.scacelith.com` and any community server, answers this HTTPS API. The game uses it for everything outside a game itself: sign-up and sign-in (two-step verification and Google included), the account page, game history, PGN downloads and animated GIFs of games, signed-in devices, the data download, the deletion of the account, and reports.

Live play (matchmaking, challenges, moves, clocks) goes through the WebSocket of the same server (`wss://<host>/ws`), opened with a session token of this API; it is described in `PROTOCOL.md`, not here.

Defaults below are those of a server with an untouched configuration; a community server may change them (`CONFIG.md` names every setting).

## Base URL, port and transport

- Official server: `https://caissa.scacelith.com/api/v1`, TCP port 443.
- A community server: `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>[:<port>]/api/v1`. `API_PORT` is 443 by default; behind a NAT or a proxy, the port players use is `PUBLIC_API_PORT`.
- The game's WebSocket is on the same port by default (`WS_PORT` moves it; `GET /info` tells the client where it is).
- HTTP/1.1 over TLS. With `TLS_MODE=proxy`, a reverse proxy terminates TLS in front of the server. `TLS_MODE=off` (plain HTTP) is for local development only.
- The HTML pages opened from the links of e-mails (`/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/confirm-email-change`) live at the root of the server, outside `/api/v1`. The health endpoints answer both at the root and under `/api/v1`. Google sign-in has no page on the server: Google sends the browser back to the game itself, on `127.0.0.1`, or to a page of the website that started it (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`).
- A trailing slash is ignored (`/api/v1/info/` is `/api/v1/info`), and path parameters are URL-decoded (a parameter that is not valid URL encoding answers 400 `invalid_request`).

## Requests

- **JSON bodies.** `POST`, `PUT` and `DELETE` requests carry a JSON object with `Content-Type: application/json`. A `charset` other than UTF-8 is refused, and so is any other content type (415 `unsupported_media_type`). An empty body counts as `{}`, which is what the endpoints without parameters take (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`).
- **Size and time.** A body is limited to `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` bytes (16,384 by default; `POST /gif` has its own limit of 135,168 bytes): 413 `payload_too_large`. It must arrive within 10 seconds: 408 `request_timeout`. After either error the server closes the connection.
- **Strict schemas.** A field that the endpoint does not know is refused, a field not marked optional is required, and types and lengths are checked. Any of these failures answers 400 `invalid_request`, with `field` naming the field (dotted for a nested one, such as `pow.nonce`). Strings may not contain control characters. Lengths count UTF-16 code units, so a character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (an emoji) counts twice. A body that is not JSON answers 400 `invalid_json`. `POST /gif` and `POST /reports` check their bodies themselves (see each endpoint).
- **Query strings.** The first occurrence of a parameter counts, unknown parameters are ignored, and a `+` decodes to a space: the endpoints that take a time-control category accept both `3%2B2` and `3+2`.
- **Methods.** `HEAD` is `GET` without the body. `OPTIONS` on an existing path answers 204 with an `Allow` header (and the headers of a CORS preflight, below). Any other method that the path does not have answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow`.
- **Request target.** It may not exceed 4096 characters (414 `uri_too_long`). A request that cannot be parsed at all, or whose head is too large or arrives too slowly, gets an empty 400, 431 or 408 answer and the connection is closed.
- **CORS: an allow-list, off by default.** The API serves the game, which sends no `Origin`. With `CORS_ORIGINS` empty (the default) no `Access-Control-*` header is ever sent, so no web page can read an answer. `CORS_ORIGINS` lists the web origins whose pages may call the API from a browser, each exactly as browsers send it in `Origin`: `https://host` or `https://host:port`, in lower case, without a path, a trailing slash or the default port; `http://` only for `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` (local development); no wildcard. The official server sets `CORS_ORIGINS=https://scacelith.com,https://www.scacelith.com` for its website. Then:
  - Every answer for a path under `/api/v1` but the health endpoints, successes and errors alike (the 429 of the per-address layer included), carries `Vary: Origin`. When the request's `Origin` is byte for byte one of the listed origins, it also carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <that origin>` and, except on the answer to a preflight, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After, Content-Disposition`, so that the page reads the error codes, `Retry-After` and the file names of the PGN and GIF downloads.
  - A preflight (`OPTIONS` with `Access-Control-Request-Method`) from a listed origin on an existing path answers 204, without a body, with `Allow`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` (the methods of `Allow`), `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600` and `Vary: Origin`. It needs no token and counts toward no account budget and no endpoint limit; like any request, it takes a token of the per-address layer. A browser reuses a preflight for 10 minutes, but only for that exact URL, query string included. A request without `Authorization` and without a JSON body, such as `GET /info` or `GET /leaderboard`, needs no preflight.
  - Any other answer to a preflight is a failed preflight, even with the CORS headers: a 404 for a path that does not exist, or the 429 of the per-address layer. The browser then does not send the request, and the page sees a network error, without the answer or its `Retry-After`.
  - `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` is never sent, nor `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`: a page sends its session token in `Authorization: Bearer`, as the game does, and the API sets no cookie. The HTML pages, the health endpoints and the empty answers to unreadable requests carry no CORS header. The WebSocket does not use CORS: `WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` lists the pages that may open it.
  - A page of an origin that is not listed reads nothing, and its cross-site writes are never sent: JSON bodies and `Authorization` need a preflight, whose answer has no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` for that origin. `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` stays on every answer: it applies only to `no-cors` requests (another site embedding an answer), never to the `cors` requests of a listed page.

## Answers and errors

- Answers are JSON in UTF-8, except the PGN download (`application/x-chess-pgn`), the animated GIFs (`image/gif`) and the HTML pages. Times are milliseconds since 1970-01-01 UTC. Ids are integers. Game ids have up to 16 digits but stay below 2^53, so a JSON number (a double) holds them exactly.
- Every answer of the API carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` and `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` (the HTML pages have a policy of their own). With `TLS_MODE=native` it also carries `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. The answers that the listener writes itself, before the API (the `GET` and `HEAD` of the health endpoints, the 429 of the per-address layer, and a 500 `internal_error` when the API fails outright), carry the same headers except `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, and their `Content-Type` is `application/json` without a charset.
- An answer must be read within 60 seconds of the moment the server has it ready, which only matters for the large ones (a GIF, the data export, a long PGN). The time the server takes to prepare an answer counts neither toward this nor toward the 30 seconds without a byte in or out after which a connection is closed.

Errors have one shape (the `Error` schema):

```json
{ "error": "snake_case_code", "message": "An English sentence.", "retryAfter": 30 }
```

`message` is meant for logs and as a fallback; a client chooses what to show from `error`. `retryAfter` (seconds) is present only on refusals that end with time, and the answer then also carries a `Retry-After` header with the same value; the one exception is the 503 `busy` of the history, game, player and leaderboard reads, which has only the field. Some errors add fields: `field` (invalid input), `reason` (`weak_password`, `pow_required`), `pow` (`pow_required`), `until` (`banned`), `line` and `column` (`invalid_pgn`).

Errors that any endpoint can give:

| Status | `error` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | The body breaks the endpoint's schema (`field` says where), the request target or `Content-Length` is malformed, a path parameter is not valid URL encoding, or the body was cut off. |
| 400 | `invalid_json` | The body is not JSON. |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | No `Authorization` header on an endpoint that needs a session. |
| 401 | `invalid_token` | The token is malformed, expired, revoked or belongs to a deleted account; also on endpoints where the session is optional. |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such endpoint. Some endpoints also use it: no such game, player or session. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | The path exists for other methods (see `Allow`). |
| 408 | `request_timeout` | The body did not arrive within 10 seconds. |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | The body exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (135,168 bytes for `POST /gif`). |
| 414 | `uri_too_long` | The request target exceeds 4096 characters. |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | The body is not `application/json`, or its charset is not UTF-8. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | A rate limit (see below): `retryAfter` plus a `Retry-After` header. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | An unexpected failure. The server logs it. |
| 503 | `timeout` | The server did not answer within 30 seconds (60 seconds for the export, 45 seconds for the GIFs with the default settings). |
| 503 | `server_busy` | A session lookup or an account change found the database locked (`retryAfter` 1), or the password hash queue is full (see below). Also, with a `retryAfter` of 2 to 5, when the server is far behind: for a `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`, the database has too many writes waiting; for any request, too many earlier requests are still running past their timeout, or the session token could not be checked within 5 seconds. The request was not run, and its rate limits took nothing. |

The read endpoints (game history, games, players, leaderboard) and the export answer 503 `busy` with `retryAfter: 1` when the database stayed locked.

Endpoints that check or hash a password can also answer one of these, both with a random `retryAfter` of 5 to 15 seconds:

- 503 `server_busy`: the server's password hash queue (`PASSWORD_HASH_QUEUE_MAX`) is full, or the wait ran out.
- 429 `rate_limited`: once the queue is half full, this client (an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /48) already has `PASSWORD_HASH_WAITERS_PER_SOURCE` hashes waiting. This 429 gives back the rate-limit tokens that the request took.

Nothing was changed and no failed attempt was counted (except on `POST /auth/sso/google/link`, whose ticket try and account failure were taken before the hash), and a reset link stays valid.

The HTML pages answer their errors as HTML pages with the same status codes.

## Authentication

The endpoints that need a session take a bearer token in the `Authorization` header (the `bearerAuth` scheme):

```
Authorization: Bearer sct_L_8GDd7uzfQ3QQWtqrsWXDTsFWzRwIvJcwIGHhjWPS8
```

- **Getting a token.** A token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) comes from `POST /auth/login`, then `POST /auth/login/mfa` when two-step verification is on, from `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` and `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (Google sign-in), and from `POST /auth/sso/complete`. Every one of them answers `{ token, expiresAt, user }`. The server stores only a SHA-256 of the token.
- **Required session.** A missing header answers 401 `unauthorized` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith"`. An invalid token answers 401 `invalid_token` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith", error="invalid_token"`. A client should forget a token that gets `invalid_token` and sign in again.
- **Optional session.** On `GET /games/{id}`, `GET /games/{id}/pgn`, `GET /players/{username}` and `GET /players/{username}/games` the session is optional. Without the header they answer the public view; if a header is sent, its token must be valid.
- **Busy store.** When the database stays locked while a token is checked, an endpoint that requires or accepts a session answers 503 `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1` (and `Retry-After`); when the check takes more than 5 seconds, it answers 503 `server_busy` with a `retryAfter` of 2 to 5. Either way the token was not judged: keep it and send the request again.
- **Lifetime.** A session ends at the first of `SESSION_MAX_DAYS` (90) after the sign-in (this is `expiresAt`) and `SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` (30) without use. Each use pushes the idle limit back; the server writes the new value at most every 5 minutes, in the background. While its database has many writes waiting it postpones that write to a later request, except within the last hour before the idle limit, so a session in use does not expire. An account keeps at most `MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER` (10) sessions: a new sign-in revokes the oldest beyond that number.
- **Revocation.** Signing out (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`) revokes sessions; so do a password change (the other sessions), a password reset and the deletion of the account (every session), and an administrator. A revocation from the API takes effect at once, and the WebSocket opened with a revoked session is closed. A password change or reset and the deletion of the account revoke in the same transaction as the change itself: when one of them fails, no session was revoked and nothing else changed either. The server caches session lookups for 30 seconds, so a revocation by the admin command, a separate process, takes effect within 30 seconds.
- **Scope.** A token belongs to one server and opens its WebSocket too. Never send it to another server.

## Rate limits and other throttles

Limits apply to one of two scopes. **Client:** an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /64 (in proxy mode, the address comes from `X-Forwarded-For` sent by a `TRUSTED_PROXIES` address); some limits also count each IPv6 /48 as a whole, on top of each of its /64 networks. **Player:** the signed-in account, whatever its address; a limit counted per player on an endpoint where the session is optional counts per client for a request without a token.

Each limit is a token bucket that holds `limit` requests and refills continuously at `limit / window`; `retryAfter` is the time until the next token. Limits marked *shared* are also counted over a sliding window of the same length, so that no window holds much more than `limit` requests. Every limit is counted for the whole server. When one of an endpoint's limits refuses a request, the tokens that its other limits took for that request are given back. A refusal answers 429 `rate_limited` with `retryAfter` and `Retry-After`.

- **Per-address layer.** Every request (any path and method, the health endpoints and WebSocket upgrades included) first takes one token of its client's budget: `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP` (600) per minute with a burst of half a minute, and `HTTP_RATE_PER_PREFIX` (4 x `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP`) for an IPv6 /48. A client may also have at most `IP_MAX_INFLIGHT` (32 x `WORKERS`) requests in progress (`retryAfter` 1 beyond). A client that keeps going after its refusals is blocked: `ABUSE_BLOCK_REFUSALS_PER_MIN` (600) refusals in one minute block it for 1 minute, then 4, 16 and 60 minutes at each new block within 6 hours. A refusal of the `auth`, `auth_*` and `reauth` limits counts 5; limits counted per player never count. Addresses in `ABUSE_EXEMPT` skip this layer, but not the account budget or the endpoint limits.
- **Account budget.** Every request that carries a valid session token also counts against its account: `USER_RATE_PER_MIN` (120) per minute for all endpoints together, whatever the address, with a burst of half a minute.

`GET /info` and `GET /leaderboard` have no limit of their own: only the per-address layer. An endpoint with several limits checks them in the order given in its description.

The server handles a request in this order: the per-address layer, then the health endpoints; endpoint match; the checks that the server is not far behind (503 `server_busy`): too many earlier requests still running past their timeout and, for a `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`, the database's write backlog; authentication, within 5 seconds (503 `server_busy` beyond); the account budget, when the request carries a session; the endpoint's limits; the body; the endpoint itself (the GIF endpoints take their render limits only when they have a GIF to make). So a request refused for its token spends none of the endpoint's tokens, and a request with an invalid body does spend them.

Other throttles, answered by the endpoints themselves:

- **Failed sign-ins on one login name** (user name or e-mail): from `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) failures on, each attempt must wait twice as long as the one before (2 s, 4 s, and so on, up to 15 minutes): 429 `too_many_attempts` with `retryAfter`. The counter forgets after an hour without failures.
- **Failed second factors at sign-in:** the same rule from the 5th wrong code of the account. One sign-in step accepts at most 5 wrong codes.
- **Second-factor codes of one account:** at most `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) codes (authenticator or recovery codes, right or wrong) per 15 minutes, from any address, at sign-in and in re-authentications; beyond it 429 `too_many_attempts` before the code is checked, so a recovery code is not used up.
- **Failed re-authentications of an account** (wrong password or code): the same rule (429 `too_many_attempts`), shared by every endpoint that re-authenticates.
- **E-mails:** one confirmation or reset mail per address every 5 minutes (the answer stays the same); one "someone tried to use your address" notice per address per hour.
- **Reports:** `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) per player in 24 hours: 429 `report_limit`.

## Proof of work

`POST /auth/register` always needs a proof of work when `POW_REGISTER_BITS` is above 0 (18 by default; `GET /info` gives it as `pow.register`). `POST /auth/login` and `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (one kind of challenge for both) need one only for 5 minutes after the server sees a wave of failed sign-ins (`POW_LOGIN_TRIGGER_PER_MIN`, then `POW_LOGIN_BITS`); a client finds out from the answer.

1. The request without a proof (or with a refused one) answers 428 `pow_required` with `reason` and a `pow` challenge `{ challenge, bits, expiresAt }`.
2. Find a nonce: a decimal string of at most 20 digits such that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` starts with `bits` zero bits (most significant bit of the first byte first). 18 bits take about 260,000 hashes on average.
3. Send the same request again with `"pow": { "challenge": "...", "nonce": "123456" }` in the body.

A challenge is valid for 2 minutes and only once, for one endpoint and one client network (an IPv4 address or IPv6 /64). It is signed, so the server keeps nothing about it until it comes back. `reason` says why a proof was refused: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.

## Re-authentication

Account changes ask for the password again and, when two-step verification is on, for a second factor:

- the password only: `POST /account/password` and `POST /account/mfa/totp/setup`;
- the password and an authenticator code, a recovery code being refused: `POST /account/mfa/recovery-codes`;
- the password and an authenticator code or a recovery code: `POST /account/mfa/totp/disable`, `POST /account/email`, `POST /account/export` and `POST /account/delete`.

In bodies, `code` holds a 6-digit authenticator code and `recoveryCode` a recovery code (`xxxx-xxxx-xx`; case, spaces and dashes do not matter). A recovery code may also be sent in `code` where recovery codes are accepted. Each code works once: a used authenticator code is refused until the next 30-second step, and a recovery code is gone once it is used.

| Status | `error` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | `invalid_password` | Wrong password, or the password was reset or changed while the request ran (nothing was changed). |
| 403 | `mfa_code_required` | Two-step verification is on and neither `code` nor `recoveryCode` was sent. |
| 403 | `invalid_code` | Wrong or already used code. |
| 400 | `password_not_set` | A Google-only account has no password yet ("Forgot password" sets one). |
| 429 | `too_many_attempts` | Too many failures, or too many codes tried, on this account. |
| 503 / 429 | `server_busy` / `rate_limited` | The password hash queue is busy. |

Failed passwords and codes count in the account's failure counter and are recorded as security events.

## Metrics port

Besides the API port, the server answers plain HTTP on the metrics port (`METRICS_PORT`, 9464, bound to `METRICS_BIND`, 127.0.0.1 by default; keep it private). It is not part of this API: `GET /healthz` answers `ok`; `GET /readyz` answers `ready` once the start-up is complete (every shard has replayed its journal and the listeners are bound) and until the shutdown begins, else 503 `not ready`; `GET /metrics` serves the Prometheus metrics and, with `METRICS_TOKEN` set, needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with that exact token.
/info/description.text:
Svaki poslužitelj Scacelith, službeni `caissa.scacelith.com` i svaki poslužitelj zajednice, pruža ovaj HTTPS API. Igra ga koristi za sve što nije sama partija: registraciju i prijavu (uključujući dvofaktorsku provjeru i Google), stranicu računa, povijest partija, preuzimanje PGN datoteka i animirane GIF-ove partija, prijavljene uređaje, preuzimanje podataka, brisanje računa i prijave protivnika.

Igra uživo (traženje protivnika, izazovi, potezi, satovi) odvija se preko WebSocketa istog poslužitelja (`wss://<host>/ws`), koji se otvara tokenom sesije ovog API-ja; opisana je u `PROTOCOL.md`, a ne ovdje.

Zadane vrijednosti u nastavku su one poslužitelja s neizmijenjenom konfiguracijom; poslužitelj zajednice može ih promijeniti (`CONFIG.md` navodi svaku postavku).

## Osnovni URL, port i prijenos

- Službeni poslužitelj: `https://caissa.scacelith.com/api/v1`, TCP port 443.
- Poslužitelj zajednice: `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>[:<port>]/api/v1`. `API_PORT` je prema zadanim postavkama 443; iza NAT-a ili proxyja port kojim se igrači služe je `PUBLIC_API_PORT`.
- WebSocket igre prema zadanim je postavkama na istom portu (`WS_PORT` ga premješta; `GET /info` govori klijentu gdje se nalazi).
- HTTP/1.1 preko TLS-a. Uz `TLS_MODE=proxy` TLS završava na obrnutom proxyju (reverse proxy) ispred poslužitelja. `TLS_MODE=off` (običan HTTP) samo je za lokalni razvoj.
- HTML stranice koje se otvaraju iz poveznica u e-porukama (`/verify-email`, `/reset-password`, `/confirm-email-change`) nalaze se u korijenu poslužitelja, izvan `/api/v1`. Krajnje točke za provjeru stanja odgovaraju i u korijenu i pod `/api/v1`. Prijava putem Googlea nema stranicu na poslužitelju: Google vraća preglednik izravno igri, na `127.0.0.1`, ili na stranicu web-mjesta koje ju je pokrenulo (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`).
- Kosa crta na kraju zanemaruje se (`/api/v1/info/` je `/api/v1/info`), a parametri putanje dekodiraju se iz URL kodiranja (na parametar koji nije valjano URL kodiran odgovor je 400 `invalid_request`).

## Zahtjevi

- **JSON tijela.** Zahtjevi `POST`, `PUT` i `DELETE` nose JSON objekt s `Content-Type: application/json`. `charset` različit od UTF-8 odbija se, kao i svaka druga vrsta sadržaja (415 `unsupported_media_type`). Prazno tijelo vrijedi kao `{}`, a upravo to primaju krajnje točke bez parametara (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`).
- **Veličina i vrijeme.** Tijelo je ograničeno na `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` bajtova (prema zadanim postavkama 16.384; `POST /gif` ima vlastito ograničenje od 135.168 bajtova): 413 `payload_too_large`. Mora stići u roku od 10 sekundi: 408 `request_timeout`. Nakon bilo koje od tih dviju pogrešaka poslužitelj zatvara vezu.
- **Stroge sheme.** Polje koje krajnja točka ne poznaje odbija se, polje koje nije označeno kao neobavezno obavezno je, a tipovi i duljine se provjeravaju. Na svaku od tih pogrešaka odgovor je 400 `invalid_request`, a `field` navodi polje (s točkama za ugniježđeno polje, npr. `pow.nonce`). Nizovi znakova ne smiju sadržavati kontrolne znakove. Duljine se broje u UTF-16 kodnim jedinicama, pa se znak izvan osnovne višejezične ravnine (BMP), npr. emoji, broji dvaput. Na tijelo koje nije JSON odgovor je 400 `invalid_json`. `POST /gif` i `POST /reports` sami provjeravaju svoja tijela (vidi pojedinu krajnju točku).
- **Upitni nizovi (query string).** Vrijedi prvo pojavljivanje parametra, nepoznati parametri zanemaruju se, a `+` se dekodira u razmak: krajnje točke koje primaju kategoriju tempa igre prihvaćaju i `3%2B2` i `3+2`.
- **Metode.** `HEAD` je `GET` bez tijela. `OPTIONS` na postojećoj putanji odgovara s 204 i zaglavljem `Allow` (te zaglavljima CORS preflight zahtjeva, u nastavku). Na svaku drugu metodu koju putanja nema odgovor je 405 `method_not_allowed` s `Allow`.
- **Cilj zahtjeva (request target).** Ne smije biti dulji od 4096 znakova (414 `uri_too_long`). Zahtjev koji se uopće ne može parsirati ili čija je glava (početni redak i zaglavlja) prevelika ili stiže presporo dobiva prazan odgovor 400, 431 ili 408, a veza se zatvara.
- **CORS: popis dopuštenih, prema zadanim postavkama isključen.** API služi igri, koja ne šalje `Origin`. Kad je `CORS_ORIGINS` prazan (zadano), nikad se ne šalje nijedno zaglavlje `Access-Control-*`, pa nijedna web-stranica ne može pročitati odgovor. `CORS_ORIGINS` navodi web-podrijetla (origins) čije stranice smiju pozivati API iz preglednika, svako točno onako kako ga preglednici šalju u `Origin`: `https://host` ili `https://host:port`, malim slovima, bez putanje, kose crte na kraju i zadanog porta; `http://` samo za `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` i `[::1]` (lokalni razvoj); bez zamjenskih znakova (wildcard). Službeni poslužitelj postavlja `CORS_ORIGINS=https://scacelith.com,https://www.scacelith.com` za svoje web-mjesto. Tada:
  - Svaki odgovor za putanju pod `/api/v1` osim krajnjih točaka za provjeru stanja, i uspješan i pogreška (uključujući 429 sloja po adresi), nosi `Vary: Origin`. Kad je `Origin` zahtjeva bajt po bajt jednak jednom od navedenih podrijetla, odgovor nosi i `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: <that origin>` te, osim u odgovoru na preflight zahtjev, `Access-Control-Expose-Headers: Retry-After, Content-Disposition`, kako bi stranica mogla pročitati kodove pogrešaka, `Retry-After` i nazive datoteka preuzetih PGN-ova i GIF-ova.
  - Na preflight zahtjev (`OPTIONS` s `Access-Control-Request-Method`) s navedenog podrijetla na postojeću putanju odgovor je 204, bez tijela, sa `Allow`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` (metode iz `Allow`), `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type`, `Access-Control-Max-Age: 600` i `Vary: Origin`. Ne treba mu token i ne računa se ni u kvotu računa ni u ograničenje krajnje točke; kao svaki zahtjev, uzima jedan žeton sloja po adresi. Preglednik ponovno koristi preflight 10 minuta, ali samo za točno taj URL, uključujući upitni niz. Zahtjevu bez `Authorization` i bez JSON tijela, kao što su `GET /info` ili `GET /leaderboard`, preflight nije potreban.
  - Svaki drugi odgovor na preflight zahtjev neuspjeli je preflight, čak i sa zaglavljima CORS: 404 za putanju koja ne postoji ili 429 sloja po adresi. Preglednik tada ne šalje zahtjev, a stranica vidi mrežnu pogrešku, bez odgovora i njegova `Retry-After`.
  - Nikad se ne šalje `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials`, kao ni `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`: stranica šalje svoj token sesije u `Authorization: Bearer`, kao i igra, a API ne postavlja nijedan kolačić. HTML stranice, krajnje točke za provjeru stanja i prazni odgovori na nečitljive zahtjeve ne nose nijedno zaglavlje CORS. WebSocket ne koristi CORS: `WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` navodi stranice koje ga smiju otvoriti.
  - Stranica podrijetla koje nije navedeno ne čita ništa, a njezini zahtjevi za pisanje prema drugom web-mjestu (cross-site) nikad se ne šalju: JSON tijela i `Authorization` zahtijevaju preflight zahtjev, čiji odgovor nema `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` za to podrijetlo. `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` ostaje na svakom odgovoru: primjenjuje se samo na zahtjeve `no-cors` (drugo web-mjesto ugrađuje odgovor), nikad na zahtjeve `cors` navedene stranice.

## Odgovori i pogreške

- Odgovori su JSON u UTF-8, osim preuzimanja PGN-a (`application/x-chess-pgn`), animiranih GIF-ova (`image/gif`) i HTML stranica. Vremena su u milisekundama od 1970-01-01 UTC. Identifikatori (id) su cijeli brojevi. Identifikatori partija imaju do 16 znamenki, ali ostaju ispod 2^53, pa ih JSON broj (double) prikazuje točno.
- Svaki odgovor API-ja nosi `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin` i `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'` (HTML stranice imaju vlastitu politiku). Uz `TLS_MODE=native` nosi i `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`. Odgovori koje slušatelj piše sam, prije API-ja (odgovori na `GET` i `HEAD` krajnjih točaka za provjeru stanja, 429 sloja po adresi i 500 `internal_error` kad API potpuno zakaže), nose ista zaglavlja osim `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy`, a njihov je `Content-Type` `application/json` bez skupa znakova (charset).
- Odgovor se mora pročitati u roku od 60 sekundi od trenutka kad ga poslužitelj ima spremnog, što je važno samo za velike odgovore (GIF, izvoz podataka, dugačak PGN). Vrijeme koje poslužitelju treba za pripremu odgovora ne računa se ni u to ni u 30 sekundi bez ijednog primljenog ili poslanog bajta nakon kojih se veza zatvara.

Pogreške imaju jedan oblik (shema `Error`):

```json
{ "error": "snake_case_code", "message": "An English sentence.", "retryAfter": 30 }
```

`message` je namijenjen zapisima u dnevnik (logovima) i kao rezervni tekst; klijent odabire što će prikazati prema `error`. `retryAfter` (u sekundama) prisutan je samo kod odbijanja koja s vremenom prestaju, a odgovor tada nosi i zaglavlje `Retry-After` s istom vrijednošću; jedina je iznimka 503 `busy` kod čitanja povijesti, partija, igrača i ljestvice, koji ima samo polje. Neke pogreške dodaju polja: `field` (neispravan unos), `reason` (`weak_password`, `pow_required`), `pow` (`pow_required`), `until` (`banned`), `line` i `column` (`invalid_pgn`).

Pogreške koje može vratiti svaka krajnja točka:

| Status | `error` | Kada |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | Tijelo krši shemu krajnje točke (`field` kaže gdje), cilj zahtjeva ili `Content-Length` neispravnog su oblika, parametar putanje nije valjano URL kodiran ili je tijelo prekinuto. |
| 400 | `invalid_json` | Tijelo nije JSON. |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | Nema zaglavlja `Authorization` na krajnjoj točki koja zahtijeva sesiju. |
| 401 | `invalid_token` | Token je neispravnog oblika, istekao, opozvan ili pripada izbrisanom računu; vraća se i na krajnjim točkama na kojima je sesija neobavezna. |
| 404 | `not_found` | Takva krajnja točka ne postoji. Koriste ga i neke krajnje točke: takva partija, igrač ili sesija ne postoji. |
| 405 | `method_not_allowed` | Putanja postoji za druge metode (vidi `Allow`). |
| 408 | `request_timeout` | Tijelo nije stiglo u roku od 10 sekundi. |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | Tijelo premašuje `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (135.168 bajtova za `POST /gif`). |
| 414 | `uri_too_long` | Cilj zahtjeva premašuje 4096 znakova. |
| 415 | `unsupported_media_type` | Tijelo nije `application/json` ili njegov skup znakova nije UTF-8. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | Ograničenje učestalosti (vidi u nastavku): `retryAfter` i zaglavlje `Retry-After`. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | Neočekivana pogreška. Poslužitelj je bilježi u dnevnik. |
| 503 | `timeout` | Poslužitelj nije odgovorio u roku od 30 sekundi (60 sekundi za izvoz, 45 sekundi za GIF-ove uz zadane postavke). |
| 503 | `server_busy` | Dohvat sesije ili promjena računa naišli su na zaključanu bazu podataka (`retryAfter` 1) ili je red za hashiranje lozinki pun (vidi u nastavku). Također, s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5, kad poslužitelj jako kasni: za `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` ili `DELETE` baza podataka ima previše zapisivanja na čekanju; za bilo koji zahtjev previše se ranijih zahtjeva još izvršava nakon isteka svog vremenskog ograničenja ili se token sesije nije mogao provjeriti u roku od 5 sekundi. Zahtjev nije izvršen, a njegova ograničenja učestalosti nisu uzela ništa. |

Krajnje točke za čitanje (povijest partija, partije, igrači, ljestvica) i izvoz odgovaraju s 503 `busy` i `retryAfter: 1` kad je baza podataka ostala zaključana.

Krajnje točke koje provjeravaju ili hashiraju lozinku mogu odgovoriti i jednim od ovih odgovora, oba sa slučajnim `retryAfter` od 5 do 15 sekundi:

- 503 `server_busy`: red za hashiranje lozinki poslužitelja (`PASSWORD_HASH_QUEUE_MAX`) je pun ili je čekanje isteklo.
- 429 `rate_limited`: red je barem do pola pun, a ovaj klijent (IPv4 adresa ili IPv6 /48) već ima `PASSWORD_HASH_WAITERS_PER_SOURCE` hashiranja na čekanju. Ovaj 429 vraća žetone ograničenja učestalosti koje je zahtjev uzeo.

Ništa nije promijenjeno i nijedan neuspjeli pokušaj nije ubrojen (osim kod `POST /auth/sso/google/link`, kod kojeg su pokušaj s tiketom i neuspjeh računa ubrojeni već prije hashiranja), a poveznica za ponovno postavljanje lozinke ostaje valjana.

HTML stranice svoje pogreške vraćaju kao HTML stranice s istim statusnim kodovima.

## Autentifikacija

Krajnje točke koje zahtijevaju sesiju primaju token nositelja (bearer token) u zaglavlju `Authorization` (shema `bearerAuth`):

```
Authorization: Bearer sct_L_8GDd7uzfQ3QQWtqrsWXDTsFWzRwIvJcwIGHhjWPS8
```

- **Dobivanje tokena.** Token (`sct_` nakon kojeg slijede 43 znaka base64url) dolazi od `POST /auth/login`, zatim od `POST /auth/login/mfa` kad je dvofaktorska provjera uključena, od `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` i `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (prijava putem Googlea) te od `POST /auth/sso/complete`. Svaka od njih odgovara s `{ token, expiresAt, user }`. Poslužitelj sprema samo SHA-256 sažetak tokena.
- **Obavezna sesija.** Na nedostajuće zaglavlje odgovor je 401 `unauthorized` s `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith"`. Na nevaljani token odgovor je 401 `invalid_token` s `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="scacelith", error="invalid_token"`. Klijent treba zaboraviti token koji dobije `invalid_token` i ponovno se prijaviti.
- **Neobavezna sesija.** Na `GET /games/{id}`, `GET /games/{id}/pgn`, `GET /players/{username}` i `GET /players/{username}/games` sesija je neobavezna. Bez zaglavlja one odgovaraju javnim prikazom; ako se zaglavlje pošalje, njegov token mora biti valjan.
- **Zauzeta pohrana.** Kad baza podataka ostane zaključana dok se token provjerava, krajnja točka koja zahtijeva ili prihvaća sesiju odgovara s 503 `server_busy` i `retryAfter: 1` (te `Retry-After`); kad provjera traje dulje od 5 sekundi, odgovara s 503 `server_busy` i `retryAfter` od 2 do 5. U oba slučaja o tokenu nije odlučeno: zadržite ga i ponovno pošaljite zahtjev.
- **Trajanje.** Sesija završava kad nastupi prvo od dvoga: `SESSION_MAX_DAYS` (90) dana nakon prijave (to je `expiresAt`) ili `SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` (30) dana bez upotrebe. Svaka upotreba pomiče granicu neaktivnosti; poslužitelj novu vrijednost zapisuje najviše svakih 5 minuta, u pozadini. Dok njegova baza podataka ima mnogo zapisivanja na čekanju, poslužitelj to zapisivanje odgađa na neki kasniji zahtjev, osim u posljednjem satu prije granice neaktivnosti, pa sesija koja se koristi ne istječe. Račun zadržava najviše `MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER` (10) sesija: nova prijava opoziva najstarije iznad tog broja.
- **Opoziv.** Odjava (`POST /auth/logout`, `POST /auth/logout-all`, `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`) opoziva sesije; isto čine promjena lozinke (ostale sesije), ponovno postavljanje lozinke i brisanje računa (sve sesije) te administrator. Opoziv putem API-ja djeluje odmah, a WebSocket otvoren opozvanom sesijom zatvara se. Promjena ili ponovno postavljanje lozinke i brisanje računa opozivaju sesije u istoj transakciji kao i sama promjena: kad neka od njih ne uspije, nijedna sesija nije opozvana i ništa drugo nije promijenjeno. Poslužitelj rezultate dohvata sesija drži u predmemoriji 30 sekundi, pa opoziv administratorskom naredbom, koja je zaseban proces, djeluje u roku od 30 sekundi.
- **Opseg.** Token pripada jednom poslužitelju i otvara i njegov WebSocket. Nikad ga ne šaljite drugom poslužitelju.

## Ograničenja učestalosti i druga ograničenja

Ograničenja se primjenjuju na jedan od dvaju opsega. **Klijent:** IPv4 adresa ili IPv6 /64 (u načinu rada s proxyjem adresa dolazi iz `X-Forwarded-For` koji šalje adresa iz `TRUSTED_PROXIES`); neka ograničenja broje i svaku IPv6 /48 kao cjelinu, uz svaku od njezinih /64 mreža. **Igrač:** prijavljeni račun, bez obzira na adresu; ograničenje koje se broji po igraču na krajnjoj točki na kojoj je sesija neobavezna broji se po klijentu za zahtjev bez tokena.

Svako je ograničenje spremnik žetona (token bucket) koji prima `limit` zahtjeva i neprekidno se puni brzinom `limit / window`; `retryAfter` je vrijeme do sljedećeg žetona. Ograničenja označena kao *dijeljena* broje se i u kliznom prozoru iste duljine, tako da nijedan prozor ne sadrži mnogo više od `limit` zahtjeva. Svako se ograničenje broji za cijeli poslužitelj. Kad jedno od ograničenja krajnje točke odbije zahtjev, žetoni koje su njezina druga ograničenja uzela za taj zahtjev vraćaju se. Na odbijanje se odgovara s 429 `rate_limited`, uz `retryAfter` i `Retry-After`.

- **Sloj po adresi.** Svaki zahtjev (bilo koja putanja i metoda, uključujući krajnje točke za provjeru stanja i nadogradnje na WebSocket) najprije uzima jedan žeton iz kvote svog klijenta: `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP` (600) u minuti s naletom (burst) od pola minute te `HTTP_RATE_PER_PREFIX` (4 x `HTTP_RATE_PER_IP`) za IPv6 /48. Klijent smije imati i najviše `IP_MAX_INFLIGHT` (32 x `WORKERS`) zahtjeva u obradi (iznad toga `retryAfter` 1). Klijent koji nastavlja i nakon odbijanja blokira se: `ABUSE_BLOCK_REFUSALS_PER_MIN` (600) odbijanja u jednoj minuti blokiraju ga na 1 minutu, a zatim na 4, 16 i 60 minuta pri svakom novom blokiranju unutar 6 sati. Odbijanje ograničenja `auth`, `auth_*` i `reauth` broji se kao 5; odbijanja ograničenja koja se broje po igraču ne broje se nikad. Adrese u `ABUSE_EXEMPT` preskaču ovaj sloj, ali ne i kvotu računa ni ograničenja krajnjih točaka.
- **Kvota računa.** Svaki zahtjev koji nosi valjani token sesije računa se i u kvotu svog računa: `USER_RATE_PER_MIN` (120) u minuti za sve krajnje točke zajedno, bez obzira na adresu, s naletom od pola minute.

`GET /info` i `GET /leaderboard` nemaju vlastito ograničenje: samo sloj po adresi. Krajnja točka s više ograničenja provjerava ih redoslijedom navedenim u svom opisu.

Poslužitelj obrađuje zahtjev ovim redoslijedom: sloj po adresi, zatim krajnje točke za provjeru stanja; pronalaženje krajnje točke; provjere da poslužitelj ne kasni jako (503 `server_busy`): previše ranijih zahtjeva koji se još izvršavaju nakon isteka svog vremenskog ograničenja te, za `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` ili `DELETE`, zaostatak zapisivanja u bazu podataka; autentifikacija, u roku od 5 sekundi (iznad toga 503 `server_busy`); kvota računa, kad zahtjev nosi sesiju; ograničenja krajnje točke; tijelo; sama krajnja točka (krajnje točke za GIF uzimaju svoja ograničenja iscrtavanja tek kad moraju izraditi GIF). Tako zahtjev odbijen zbog svog tokena ne troši nijedan žeton krajnje točke, a zahtjev s nevaljanim tijelom troši ih.

Druga ograničenja, na koja odgovaraju same krajnje točke:

- **Neuspjele prijave s jednim imenom za prijavu** (korisničko ime ili e-pošta): od `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) neuspjeha nadalje svaki pokušaj mora čekati dvostruko dulje od prethodnog (2 s, 4 s i tako dalje, do 15 minuta): 429 `too_many_attempts` s `retryAfter`. Brojač se briše nakon sat vremena bez neuspjeha.
- **Neuspjeli drugi faktori pri prijavi:** isto pravilo od 5. pogrešnog koda računa. Jedan korak prijave prihvaća najviše 5 pogrešnih kodova.
- **Kodovi drugog faktora jednog računa:** najviše `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) kodova (iz aplikacije za autentifikaciju ili za oporavak, točnih ili pogrešnih) u 15 minuta, s bilo koje adrese, pri prijavi i pri ponovnim autentifikacijama; iznad toga 429 `too_many_attempts` prije provjere koda, pa se kod za oporavak ne troši.
- **Neuspjele ponovne autentifikacije računa** (pogrešna lozinka ili kod): isto pravilo (429 `too_many_attempts`), zajedničko svim krajnjim točkama koje traže ponovnu autentifikaciju.
- **E-poruke:** jedna e-poruka za potvrdu ili za ponovno postavljanje lozinke po adresi svakih 5 minuta (odgovor ostaje isti); jedna obavijest „netko je pokušao upotrijebiti vašu adresu“ po adresi na sat.
- **Prijave protivnika:** `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) po igraču u 24 sata: 429 `report_limit`.

## Dokaz rada

`POST /auth/register` uvijek zahtijeva dokaz rada kad je `POW_REGISTER_BITS` veći od 0 (prema zadanim postavkama 18; `GET /info` daje ga kao `pow.register`). `POST /auth/login` i `POST /auth/sso/google/link` (jedna vrsta izazova za obje) zahtijevaju ga samo 5 minuta nakon što poslužitelj uoči val neuspjelih prijava (`POW_LOGIN_TRIGGER_PER_MIN`, zatim `POW_LOGIN_BITS`); klijent to saznaje iz odgovora.

1. Na zahtjev bez dokaza (ili s odbijenim dokazom) odgovor je 428 `pow_required` s `reason` i izazovom `pow` `{ challenge, bits, expiresAt }`.
2. Pronađite nonce: decimalni niz od najviše 20 znamenki takav da `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` počinje s `bits` nultih bitova (najprije najznačajniji bit prvog bajta). Za 18 bitova potrebno je u prosjeku oko 260.000 hashiranja.
3. Ponovno pošaljite isti zahtjev s `"pow": { "challenge": "...", "nonce": "123456" }` u tijelu.

Izazov vrijedi 2 minute i samo jednom, za jednu krajnju točku i jednu mrežu klijenta (IPv4 adresa ili IPv6 /64). Potpisan je, pa poslužitelj o njemu ne čuva ništa dok se ne vrati. `reason` kaže zašto je dokaz odbijen: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` ili `replayed`.

## Ponovna autentifikacija

Promjene računa ponovno traže lozinku i, kad je dvofaktorska provjera uključena, drugi faktor:

- samo lozinku: `POST /account/password` i `POST /account/mfa/totp/setup`;
- lozinku i kod iz aplikacije, pri čemu se kod za oporavak odbija: `POST /account/mfa/recovery-codes`;
- lozinku i kod iz aplikacije ili kod za oporavak: `POST /account/mfa/totp/disable`, `POST /account/email`, `POST /account/export` i `POST /account/delete`.

U tijelima `code` sadrži šesteroznamenkasti kod iz aplikacije za autentifikaciju, a `recoveryCode` kod za oporavak (`xxxx-xxxx-xx`; velika i mala slova, razmaci i crtice nisu važni). Kod za oporavak može se poslati i u `code` ondje gdje se kodovi za oporavak prihvaćaju. Svaki kod vrijedi jednom: upotrijebljeni kod iz aplikacije odbija se do sljedećeg 30-sekundnog koraka, a kod za oporavak nestaje čim se upotrijebi.

| Status | `error` | Kada |
|---|---|---|
| 403 | `invalid_password` | Pogrešna lozinka ili je lozinka ponovno postavljena ili promijenjena dok se zahtjev izvršavao (ništa nije promijenjeno). |
| 403 | `mfa_code_required` | Dvofaktorska provjera je uključena, a nije poslan ni `code` ni `recoveryCode`. |
| 403 | `invalid_code` | Pogrešan ili već upotrijebljen kod. |
| 400 | `password_not_set` | Račun samo s prijavom putem Googlea još nema lozinku („Zaboravljena lozinka?“ je postavlja). |
| 429 | `too_many_attempts` | Previše neuspjeha ili previše isprobanih kodova na ovom računu. |
| 503 / 429 | `server_busy` / `rate_limited` | Red za hashiranje lozinki je zauzet. |

Pogrešne lozinke i kodovi broje se u brojaču neuspjeha računa i bilježe se kao sigurnosni događaji.

## Port za metrike

Osim na portu API-ja, poslužitelj odgovara običnim HTTP-om na portu za metrike (`METRICS_PORT`, 9464, vezan na `METRICS_BIND`, prema zadanim postavkama 127.0.0.1; neka ostane privatan). On nije dio ovog API-ja: `GET /healthz` odgovara s `ok`; `GET /readyz` odgovara s `ready` kad je pokretanje dovršeno (svaki je shard ponovno izveo svoj dnevnik (journal), a slušatelji su vezani) i sve dok ne počne gašenje, inače 503 `not ready`; `GET /metrics` poslužuje metrike za Prometheus i, kad je postavljen `METRICS_TOKEN`, zahtijeva `Authorization: Bearer <token>` s točno tim tokenom.

/tags/3/description.en:
Offered when `GET /info` says `sso.google: true`; otherwise every endpoint below answers 404 `sso_disabled`. A website signs in the same way with its own client when `sso.googleWeb` is true (below, **On a website**). The game signs in through the system browser with the installed-app flow of RFC 8252 (a "Desktop app" client): Google sends the browser back to a listener of the game on `127.0.0.1`, never to this server, and the game never sees a Google credential.

1. The client listens on `127.0.0.1:0` (the system picks the port) and makes a PKCE pair: a `codeVerifier` of 43 to 128 characters `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` and `codeChallenge = BASE64URL(SHA-256(codeVerifier))`, which has 43 characters and no padding.
2. `POST /auth/sso/google/start` with the challenge and the port returns the Google URL and the attempt's `state`. The client checks the URL (below) and opens it in the browser.
3. Google sends the browser to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth2/google/<tag>?code=...&state=...`. The client accepts only the `state` of the start answer, and sends nothing after an `error=` redirect.
4. `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` with the attempt id, the `codeVerifier`, the `state` and the `code` (and `iss` when Google sent it).
5. The answer is a session, a two-step verification step (continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`), `needsUsername` for a new player (continue with `POST /auth/sso/complete`), or `needsPassword` when an account with a password uses the address (continue with `POST /auth/sso/google/link`).

**The origin tag.** The redirect URI carries a tag of the server the player added, so that a URL another server got for its own players is refused by the game. The origin is the lower-case host (an IPv6 literal in brackets), `:` and the decimal API port, always written, 443 included: the server takes `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` and its public API port, the game the address it is connected to. The tag is the first 22 characters of the base64url (no padding) of SHA-256(UTF-8 `"scacelith-sso-origin-v1\n"` + origin). The redirect URI is `"http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/oauth2/google/" + tag`: always the IPv4 literal, and the port of the game's listener (1024 to 65535). The server never takes a URI, host or path from the client.

| Origin | Tag |
|---|---|
| `play.scacelith.example:443` | `IhcScoV7eDOzTEcSnqPUPt` |
| `localhost:8443` | `TFGx7zQ_8QlGZW5zpqznCr` |
| `[::1]:8443` | `XToJm0DG5PjciEVmZa9Cho` |
| `127.0.0.1:50443` | `3r653wM5ZjYsHcAJljmCwY` |

So Google sign-in works only for players who added the server under exactly `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` and its public API port.

**What the game checks before it opens the browser.** The `authUrl` starts with exactly `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?` and is printable ASCII under 4096 characters, and its query has exactly one `response_type=code`, exactly one `redirect_uri` equal to the URI the game computes from its port and its origin tag, exactly one `state` equal to the answer's `state`, `code_challenge_method=S256` and a 43-character `code_challenge`. Otherwise the game stops its listener and opens nothing. It posts `finish` and `link` only to the server that answered `start`.

**On a website.** A website (the official one: <https://scacelith.com/>) signs in with a "Web application" client of the same Google project (`GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID`). Google sends the browser back to one page of the site that the operator configured (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, listed in the client's "Authorized redirect URIs"), and that page posts the code to `finish`; the server takes no redirect URI from the client here either.

1. The page makes a PKCE pair as above, keeps the verifier in the tab (`sessionStorage`), and sends `POST /auth/sso/google/web/start` with the challenge.
2. It checks the `authUrl` as the game does, except that its `redirect_uri` must be a page of its own origin, then navigates to it. No Google script is loaded.
3. Google sends the browser to `GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI?code=...&state=...`. The page accepts only the `state` of the start answer and sends nothing after an `error=` redirect.
4. `finish`, `link` and `complete` follow as for the game. The attempt remembers that a website started it: the code is exchanged with the website's client and page, and the ID token must name that client (a code or ID token of the game's client fails with 502 `sso_failed`, and the reverse).

A Google account reaches the same Scacelith account from the game and from the website: the link holds Google's subject (`sub`), which identifies the Google account whatever the client. The website's origin must be in `CORS_ORIGINS` (`check-config` warns otherwise).

**Which account the Google sign-in reaches:** the account already linked to that Google account; otherwise an active account with the address that Google confirmed (with a password, `finish` answers `needsPassword` and the link is stored only once its password, then its second factor when it is on, pass; without a password, 409 `sso_account_exists`); otherwise a new account (`needsUsername`). A Google account is never linked to an existing account by its address alone. The account's address gets a mail when Google sign-in creates an account and when it is added to an existing one.
/tags/3/description.text:
Dostupna je kad `GET /info` kaže `sso.google: true`; inače svaka krajnja točka u nastavku odgovara s 404 `sso_disabled`. Web-mjesto se prijavljuje na isti način vlastitim klijentom kad je `sso.googleWeb` true (u nastavku, **Na web-mjestu**). Igra se prijavljuje preko preglednika sustava tokom za instalirane aplikacije iz RFC 8252 (klijent tipa „Desktop app“): Google vraća preglednik slušatelju igre na `127.0.0.1`, nikad ovom poslužitelju, a igra nikad ne vidi nijednu Googleovu vjerodajnicu.

1. Klijent sluša na `127.0.0.1:0` (sustav bira port) i izrađuje PKCE par: `codeVerifier` od 43 do 128 znakova `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` i `codeChallenge = BASE64URL(SHA-256(codeVerifier))`, koji ima 43 znaka i nema dopune (padding).
2. `POST /auth/sso/google/start` s izazovom i portom vraća Googleov URL i `state` pokušaja. Klijent provjerava URL (u nastavku) i otvara ga u pregledniku.
3. Google šalje preglednik na `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth2/google/<tag>?code=...&state=...`. Klijent prihvaća samo `state` iz odgovora na start i ne šalje ništa nakon preusmjeravanja s `error=`.
4. `POST /auth/sso/google/finish` s ID-om pokušaja, `codeVerifier`, `state` i `code` (te `iss` kad ga je Google poslao).
5. Odgovor je sesija, korak dvofaktorske provjere (nastavite s `POST /auth/login/mfa`), `needsUsername` za novog igrača (nastavite s `POST /auth/sso/complete`) ili `needsPassword` kad adresu koristi račun s lozinkom (nastavite s `POST /auth/sso/google/link`).

**Oznaka podrijetla.** URI za preusmjeravanje nosi oznaku poslužitelja koji je igrač dodao, tako da igra odbija URL koji je neki drugi poslužitelj dobio za svoje igrače. Podrijetlo je host malim slovima (IPv6 literal u uglatim zagradama), `:` i decimalni port API-ja, uvijek napisan, uključujući 443: poslužitelj uzima `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` i svoj javni port API-ja, a igra adresu na koju je povezana. Oznaka je prva 22 znaka base64url kodiranja (bez dopune) vrijednosti SHA-256(UTF-8 `"scacelith-sso-origin-v1\n"` + podrijetlo). URI za preusmjeravanje je `"http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/oauth2/google/" + tag`: uvijek IPv4 literal i port slušatelja igre (od 1024 do 65535). Poslužitelj nikad ne uzima URI, host ni putanju od klijenta.

| Podrijetlo | Oznaka |
|---|---|
| `play.scacelith.example:443` | `IhcScoV7eDOzTEcSnqPUPt` |
| `localhost:8443` | `TFGx7zQ_8QlGZW5zpqznCr` |
| `[::1]:8443` | `XToJm0DG5PjciEVmZa9Cho` |
| `127.0.0.1:50443` | `3r653wM5ZjYsHcAJljmCwY` |

Stoga prijava putem Googlea radi samo za igrače koji su poslužitelj dodali točno pod `SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST` i s njegovim javnim portom API-ja.

**Što igra provjerava prije otvaranja preglednika.** `authUrl` počinje točno s `https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?` i ispisivi je ASCII kraći od 4096 znakova, a njegov upit sadrži točno jedan `response_type=code`, točno jedan `redirect_uri` jednak URI-ju koji igra izračunava iz svog porta i svoje oznake podrijetla, točno jedan `state` jednak `state` iz odgovora, `code_challenge_method=S256` i `code_challenge` od 43 znaka. U suprotnom igra zaustavlja svog slušatelja i ništa ne otvara. `finish` i `link` šalje samo poslužitelju koji je odgovorio na `start`.

**Na web-mjestu.** Web-mjesto (službeno: <https://scacelith.com/>) prijavljuje se klijentom tipa „Web application“ istog Google projekta (`GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID`). Google vraća preglednik na jednu stranicu web-mjesta koju je operater konfigurirao (`GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, navedena među „Authorized redirect URIs“ klijenta), a ta stranica šalje kod na `finish`; ni ovdje poslužitelj ne uzima URI za preusmjeravanje od klijenta.

1. Stranica izrađuje PKCE par kao gore, čuva verifikator u kartici (`sessionStorage`) i šalje `POST /auth/sso/google/web/start` s izazovom.
2. Provjerava `authUrl` kao i igra, osim što njegov `redirect_uri` mora biti stranica njezina vlastitog podrijetla, a zatim prelazi na njega. Ne učitava se nijedna Googleova skripta.
3. Google šalje preglednik na `GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI?code=...&state=...`. Stranica prihvaća samo `state` iz odgovora na start i ne šalje ništa nakon preusmjeravanja s `error=`.
4. `finish`, `link` i `complete` slijede kao za igru. Pokušaj pamti da ga je pokrenulo web-mjesto: kod se razmjenjuje s klijentom i stranicom web-mjesta, a ID token mora navoditi taj klijent (kod ili ID token klijenta igre ne uspijeva s 502 `sso_failed`, i obrnuto).

Google račun iz igre i s web-mjesta dolazi do istog računa Scacelith: povezivanje sadrži Googleov subjekt (`sub`), koji identificira Google račun bez obzira na klijent. Podrijetlo web-mjesta mora biti u `CORS_ORIGINS` (inače `check-config` upozorava).

**Do kojeg računa vodi prijava putem Googlea:** do računa koji je već povezan s tim Google računom; inače do aktivnog računa s adresom koju je Google potvrdio (ako ima lozinku, `finish` odgovara s `needsPassword`, a povezivanje se sprema tek kad prođu njegova lozinka, a zatim i drugi faktor ako je uključen; bez lozinke 409 `sso_account_exists`); inače do novog računa (`needsUsername`). Google račun nikad se ne povezuje s postojećim računom samo na temelju adrese. Na adresu računa stiže e-poruka kad prijava putem Googlea izradi račun i kad se doda postojećem računu.

/tags/11/description.en:
Game records with their moves and clocks, and their PGN files.

**Game codes.** `status`: 1 `WhiteWins`, 2 `BlackWins`, 3 `Draw`, 4 `Aborted` (only finished games are stored). `result`: `1-0`, `0-1`, `1/2-1/2`, or `*` (aborted). `reason`, with its name (`termination`) and the words that end the PGN file's move text; codes 7, 14 and 21 are draws (the player who ran out of time, resigned or abandoned faced an opponent who could not checkmate: FIDE 6.9 and 5.1.2; `DESIGN.md` 6.3 gives the rule), and the server never ends a game with codes 4 and 13 (they belong to the shared list of reasons):

| Code | `termination` | Words in the PGN |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Checkmate` | Checkmate |
| 2 | `Resignation` | Resignation |
| 3 | `Timeout` | Loss on time |
| 4 | `IllegalMoves` | Second illegal move (forfeit) |
| 5 | `Stalemate` | Stalemate |
| 6 | `InsufficientMaterial` | Dead position (insufficient material) |
| 7 | `TimeoutVsInsufficient` | Flag fall, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 8 | `FivefoldRepetition` | Fivefold repetition |
| 9 | `SeventyFiveMoves` | 75-move rule |
| 10 | `ThreefoldClaim` | Threefold repetition (claimed) |
| 11 | `FiftyMoveClaim` | 50-move rule (claimed) |
| 12 | `Agreement` | Draw by agreement |
| 13 | `IllegalMovesVsInsufficient` | Second illegal move, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 14 | `ResignationVsInsufficient` | Resignation, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 20 | `Abandonment` | Abandoned (disconnected for too long) |
| 21 | `AbandonmentVsInsufficient` | Abandoned, but the opponent cannot checkmate |
| 22 | `Aborted` | Game aborted |
| 23 | `NoShow` | Aborted: first move not played in time |
| 24 | `Forfeit` | Forfeit (fair play violation) |
| 25 | `ServerAborted` | Aborted by the server |
| 26 | `BothDisconnected` | Aborted: both players disconnected |

Code 14 is new in protocol minor 1: a client written before it should show an unknown code as a plain end of game with its `result`.
/tags/11/description.text:
Zapisi partija s potezima i satovima te njihove PGN datoteke.

**Kodovi partija.** `status`: 1 `WhiteWins`, 2 `BlackWins`, 3 `Draw`, 4 `Aborted` (spremaju se samo završene partije). `result`: `1-0`, `0-1`, `1/2-1/2` ili `*` (poništena). `reason`, s nazivom (`termination`) i riječima kojima završava tekst poteza u PGN datoteci; kodovi 7, 14 i 21 su remiji (igrač kojem je isteklo vrijeme, koji je predao ili koji je napustio partiju igrao je protiv protivnika koji nije mogao dati mat: FIDE 6.9 i 5.1.2; `DESIGN.md` 6.3 navodi pravilo), a poslužitelj nikad ne završava partiju kodovima 4 i 13 (pripadaju zajedničkom popisu razloga):

| Kod | `termination` | Riječi u PGN-u |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Checkmate` | Checkmate (mat) |
| 2 | `Resignation` | Resignation (predaja) |
| 3 | `Timeout` | Loss on time (poraz zbog isteka vremena) |
| 4 | `IllegalMoves` | Second illegal move (forfeit) (drugi nepravilan potez, poraz) |
| 5 | `Stalemate` | Stalemate (pat) |
| 6 | `InsufficientMaterial` | Dead position (insufficient material) (mrtva pozicija, nedovoljno materijala) |
| 7 | `TimeoutVsInsufficient` | Flag fall, but the opponent cannot checkmate (isteklo vrijeme, ali protivnik ne može dati mat) |
| 8 | `FivefoldRepetition` | Fivefold repetition (peterostruko ponavljanje pozicije) |
| 9 | `SeventyFiveMoves` | 75-move rule (pravilo 75 poteza) |
| 10 | `ThreefoldClaim` | Threefold repetition (claimed) (trostruko ponavljanje pozicije, na zahtjev) |
| 11 | `FiftyMoveClaim` | 50-move rule (claimed) (pravilo 50 poteza, na zahtjev) |
| 12 | `Agreement` | Draw by agreement (remi dogovorom) |
| 13 | `IllegalMovesVsInsufficient` | Second illegal move, but the opponent cannot checkmate (drugi nepravilan potez, ali protivnik ne može dati mat) |
| 14 | `ResignationVsInsufficient` | Resignation, but the opponent cannot checkmate (predaja, ali protivnik ne može dati mat) |
| 20 | `Abandonment` | Abandoned (disconnected for too long) (napuštena partija: predugo bez veze) |
| 21 | `AbandonmentVsInsufficient` | Abandoned, but the opponent cannot checkmate (napuštena partija, ali protivnik ne može dati mat) |
| 22 | `Aborted` | Game aborted (partija poništena) |
| 23 | `NoShow` | Aborted: first move not played in time (poništeno: prvi potez nije odigran na vrijeme) |
| 24 | `Forfeit` | Forfeit (fair play violation) (kontumacija zbog kršenja pravila poštene igre) |
| 25 | `ServerAborted` | Aborted by the server (poslužitelj je poništio partiju) |
| 26 | `BothDisconnected` | Aborted: both players disconnected (poništeno: oba su igrača izgubila vezu) |

Kod 14 nov je u manjoj verziji (minor) 1 protokola: klijent napisan prije nje treba nepoznati kod prikazati kao običan kraj partije s njegovim `result`.

/tags/12/description.en:
A game as an animated GIF, to keep or to share: the board seen from above, one frame per position from the start to the final position, the players' names and ratings above the board, the last move below it, and on the last frame the result and how the game ended.

**Cost, cache and quotas.** A GIF is made on a rendering thread of its own, never on the threads that run the games, and at the lowest CPU priority: `GIF_THREADS` threads (`WORKERS` by default), started with the first GIF and stopped after a minute without one. Up to `GIF_QUEUE_MAX` (4 x `WORKERS`) GIFs wait for a thread, at most `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 s) each; a render may last `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` (30 s). The server keeps the GIFs it made in a cache of `GIF_CACHE_MB` MB (32 x `WORKERS`), the least recently used going first; a GIF from the cache, or one being made for another request, costs no render. The cache keys on everything that changes the picture, names included.

Every request counts in `gif` (30 per minute per player for both endpoints). A GIF that has to be made also counts in the render limits: per player `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (4) per minute and `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (30) per hour; per client, all its accounts together, `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (12) per minute and `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (120) per hour, and 3 times that per IPv6 /48. A client should keep the file it downloaded rather than ask for it again, and wait `retryAfter` after a 429 or a 503.

Sizes: `small` (32 px squares: 284 x 350 pixels), `medium` (48 px: 424 x 515), `large` (72 px: 628 x 762); without coordinates 268 x 342, 400 x 503 and 600 x 748. The start position stays at least 1 s (the delay when it is longer), the final position 3 s, and the GIF loops; after the first frame, only the part of the picture that changes is stored. A 40-move game takes about 135, 205 and 325 KiB (small, medium, large), a 150-move game 0.5, 0.8 and 1.2 MiB.
/tags/12/description.text:
Partija kao animirani GIF, za čuvanje ili dijeljenje: ploča gledana odozgo, jedan okvir po poziciji od početne do završne pozicije, imena i rejtinzi igrača iznad ploče, posljednji potez ispod nje, a na posljednjem okviru rezultat i način na koji je partija završila.

**Trošak, predmemorija i kvote.** GIF se izrađuje u vlastitoj dretvi za iscrtavanje, nikad u dretvama koje vode partije, i uz najniži prioritet CPU-a: `GIF_THREADS` dretvi (prema zadanim postavkama `WORKERS`), koje se pokreću s prvim GIF-om i zaustavljaju nakon minute bez ijednog GIF-a. Do `GIF_QUEUE_MAX` (4 x `WORKERS`) GIF-ova čeka na dretvu, svaki najviše `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` (10 s); iscrtavanje smije trajati `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` (30 s). Poslužitelj GIF-ove koje je izradio čuva u predmemoriji od `GIF_CACHE_MB` MB (32 x `WORKERS`), iz koje najprije izlaze najdulje nekorišteni; GIF iz predmemorije ili onaj koji se već izrađuje za drugi zahtjev ne troši iscrtavanje. Ključ predmemorije obuhvaća sve što mijenja sliku, uključujući imena.

Svaki zahtjev broji se u `gif` (30 u minuti po igraču za obje krajnje točke). GIF koji se mora izraditi broji se i u ograničenja iscrtavanja: po igraču `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (4) u minuti i `GIF_USER_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (30) na sat; po klijentu, za sve njegove račune zajedno, `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_MIN` (12) u minuti i `GIF_IP_RENDERS_PER_HOUR` (120) na sat, te triput toliko po IPv6 /48. Klijent treba zadržati preuzetu datoteku umjesto da je ponovno traži te nakon 429 ili 503 pričekati `retryAfter`.

Veličine: `small` (polja od 32 px: 284 x 350 piksela), `medium` (48 px: 424 x 515), `large` (72 px: 628 x 762); bez koordinata 268 x 342, 400 x 503 i 600 x 748. Početna pozicija ostaje najmanje 1 s (ili koliko iznosi odgoda, ako je dulja), završna pozicija 3 s, a GIF se vrti u petlji; nakon prvog okvira sprema se samo dio slike koji se mijenja. Partija od 40 poteza zauzima oko 135, 205 i 325 KiB (small, medium, large), a partija od 150 poteza 0,5; 0,8 i 1,2 MiB.

/tags/16/description.en:
Pages for a browser, opened from the links of e-mails. Their links point to `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>` (with `:<PUBLIC_API_PORT>` when it is not 443), outside `/api/v1`.

- The pages run no JavaScript and load no external resource. They are served with `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`.
- A `GET` only shows a button or a form, so that a mail scanner opening the link does not use it up. The change happens on `POST`: a form sent as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (a JSON body is accepted too), with the link's token in a hidden field. A field given twice is refused.
- Errors (rate limits, invalid fields) are HTML pages too, titled "Request refused" or, from 500 on, "Server error". Only the failures found before the page is matched (a request target that is too long or malformed, the per-address layer) answer in JSON.
/tags/16/description.text:
Stranice za preglednik, koje se otvaraju iz poveznica u e-porukama. Njihove poveznice vode na `https://<SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST>` (s `:<PUBLIC_API_PORT>` kad port nije 443), izvan `/api/v1`.

- Stranice ne izvršavaju JavaScript i ne učitavaju nikakve vanjske resurse. Poslužuju se sa `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'`.
- `GET` samo prikazuje gumb ili obrazac, kako poveznicu ne bi potrošio skener e-pošte koji je otvori. Promjena se događa na `POST`: obrazac poslan kao `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` (prihvaća se i JSON tijelo), s tokenom poveznice u skrivenom polju. Polje navedeno dvaput odbija se.
- I pogreške (ograničenja učestalosti, nevaljana polja) su HTML stranice, s naslovom „Request refused“ (zahtjev odbijen) ili, od 500 naviše, „Server error“ (pogreška poslužitelja). Samo pogreške otkrivene prije nego što se pronađe stranica (predugačak ili neispravan cilj zahtjeva, sloj po adresi) vraćaju se u JSON-u.

/paths/~1info/get/description.en:
What a client needs before it signs in or connects: the server's name and id, the WebSocket protocol versions and where the WebSocket is, the sign-up rules, the official time controls and the limits a client can check before it sends a form.

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1info/get/description.text:
Ono što klijentu treba prije nego što se prijavi ili poveže: naziv i id poslužitelja, verzije protokola WebSocketa i gdje se WebSocket nalazi, pravila registracije, službeni tempovi igre i ograničenja koja klijent može provjeriti prije slanja obrasca.

**Ograničenja:** samo sloj po adresi.

/paths/~1info/get/responses/503/descript.en: `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1info/get/responses/503/descript.text: `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/description.en:
Creates an account: once its e-mail address is confirmed with the link sent to it, or at once without e-mail confirmation.

**With e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, the default): 202 `verification_sent`. No account exists yet: the signup waits for 24 hours and holds its username meanwhile. A link valid for those 24 hours goes to the address, at most one per address every 5 minutes (`POST /auth/verify-email/resend` sends a new one); the account is created, its address confirmed, when the link is used (the button of the `/verify-email` page), and the player can then sign in. Until then a sign-in with that username answers `invalid_credentials`, as for an unknown account, and the public profile does not exist. A new signup with the same address replaces the waiting one. The answer is the same when another account already uses the address: no link is sent then, its owner gets a notice instead (at most one per hour), and the username is held in the same way, so that nothing tells whether the address has an account. A signup whose link was not used is dropped after 24 hours, and its username is free again.

**Without e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): 201 `ready`, the account is created at once and can sign in.

**Rules.** `username`: `USERNAME_MIN` to `USERNAME_MAX` characters (3 to 20), letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or a digit (`GET /info` gives them as `limits`); reserved names (`admin`, `moderator`, `deleted`...) and some prefixes are refused; unique without regard to case. `email`: trimmed and stored in lower case, plain ASCII with a dotted domain. `password`: at least `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` (10) characters and at most 256 bytes of UTF-8; it must not contain the user name or the e-mail's local part, and must not be a common password.

**Errors**, checked in this order: 403 `registration_closed`; 400 `invalid_username`; 400 `invalid_email`; 400 `weak_password`; 409 `username_taken`; 428 `pow_required`; the password hash queue errors; 409 `email_taken` (only without e-mail confirmation).

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_register` (10 registrations per hour per client). **Proof of work:** always, when `POW_REGISTER_BITS` is above 0.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/description.text:
Izrađuje račun: kad se njegova adresa e-pošte potvrdi poveznicom poslanom na nju ili odmah, bez potvrde e-pošte.

**S potvrdom e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`, zadano): 202 `verification_sent`. Račun još ne postoji: registracija čeka 24 sata i za to vrijeme drži svoje korisničko ime. Na adresu stiže poveznica valjana tih 24 sata, najviše jedna po adresi svakih 5 minuta (`POST /auth/verify-email/resend` šalje novu); račun se izrađuje, s potvrđenom adresom, kad se poveznica upotrijebi (gumb na stranici `/verify-email`), i igrač se tada može prijaviti. Do tada se na prijavu s tim korisničkim imenom odgovara s `invalid_credentials`, kao za nepoznati račun, a javni profil ne postoji. Nova registracija s istom adresom zamjenjuje onu na čekanju. Odgovor je isti kad adresu već koristi drugi račun: tada se poveznica ne šalje, nego njegov vlasnik dobiva obavijest (najviše jednu na sat), a korisničko ime drži se na isti način, tako da ništa ne otkriva ima li adresa račun. Registracija čija poveznica nije upotrijebljena odbacuje se nakon 24 sata, a njezino korisničko ime ponovno je slobodno.

**Bez potvrde e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): 201 `ready`, račun se izrađuje odmah i može se prijaviti.

**Pravila.** `username`: od `USERNAME_MIN` do `USERNAME_MAX` znakova (od 3 do 20), slova, znamenke, `_` i `-`, s početnim slovom ili znamenkom (`GET /info` daje ih kao `limits`); rezervirana imena (`admin`, `moderator`, `deleted`...) i neki prefiksi odbijaju se; jedinstveno bez obzira na velika i mala slova. `email`: bez razmaka na početku i kraju, sprema se malim slovima, običan ASCII s domenom koja sadrži točku. `password`: najmanje `PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` (10) znakova i najviše 256 bajtova UTF-8; ne smije sadržavati korisničko ime ni lokalni dio adrese e-pošte i ne smije biti uobičajena lozinka.

**Pogreške**, provjeravane ovim redoslijedom: 403 `registration_closed`; 400 `invalid_username`; 400 `invalid_email`; 400 `weak_password`; 409 `username_taken`; 428 `pow_required`; pogreške reda za hashiranje lozinki; 409 `email_taken` (samo bez potvrde e-pošte).

**Ograničenja:** `auth`, zatim `auth_register` (10 registracija na sat po klijentu). **Dokaz rada:** uvijek, kad je `POW_REGISTER_BITS` veći od 0.

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/requestBody.en: First attempt, without a proof of work
Sent again with the proof of work

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.en: The account is created and can sign in (no e-mail confirmation on this server).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.text: Račun je izrađen i može se prijaviti (na ovom poslužitelju nema potvrde e-pošte).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.en: The signup waits for its confirmation link (or the address already has an account; the answer does not tell).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/2.text: Registracija čeka svoju poveznicu za potvrdu (ili adresa već ima račun; odgovor to ne otkriva).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `registration_closed`: registration is closed on this server (`GET /info` says `registration: closed`).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `registration_closed`: registracija je na ovom poslužitelju zatvorena (`GET /info` kaže `registration: closed`).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `username_taken`: an account has the username, or a waiting signup of another address holds it. `email_taken`: another account uses the address (only without e-mail confirmation).
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `username_taken`: neki račun ima to korisničko ime ili ga drži registracija na čekanju s drugom adresom. `email_taken`: adresu koristi drugi račun (samo bez potvrde e-pošte).

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.en: `rate_limited`: the `auth` or `auth_register` limit, or the password hash queue.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/4.text: `rate_limited`: ograničenje `auth` ili `auth_register` ili red za hashiranje lozinki.

/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/5.en: `server_busy` (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1register/post/responses/5.text: `server_busy` (red za hashiranje lozinki ili je baza podataka ostala zaključana), `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/description.en:
Signs in with a user name or e-mail address and a password. There are two possible answers, both with status 200: a session, or, when two-step verification is on, a second step to complete within 5 minutes with `POST /auth/login/mfa`.

Unknown account, wrong password and account without a password get the same answer, after the same time: 401 `invalid_credentials`. The account checks (`banned`, `email_unverified`) come only after a correct password. From `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) failures on one login name, each attempt must wait (429 `too_many_attempts`).

**Limit:** `auth`. **Proof of work:** only during a wave of failed sign-ins (428 `pow_required`).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/description.text:
Prijava korisničkim imenom ili adresom e-pošte i lozinkom. Moguća su dva odgovora, oba sa statusom 200: sesija ili, kad je dvofaktorska provjera uključena, drugi korak koji treba dovršiti u roku od 5 minuta s `POST /auth/login/mfa`.

Nepoznati račun, pogrešna lozinka i račun bez lozinke dobivaju isti odgovor, nakon jednakog vremena: 401 `invalid_credentials`. Provjere računa (`banned`, `email_unverified`) dolaze tek nakon točne lozinke. Od `AUTH_FAILURES_PER_ACCOUNT` (5) neuspjeha s jednim imenom za prijavu svaki pokušaj mora čekati (429 `too_many_attempts`).

**Ograničenje:** `auth`. **Dokaz rada:** samo tijekom vala neuspjelih prijava (428 `pow_required`).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/200/.en: A session, or the second step of a sign-in with two-step verification.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/200/.text: Sesija ili drugi korak prijave s dvofaktorskom provjerom.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/401/.en: `invalid_credentials`: unknown account, wrong password, or an account without a password.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/401/.text: `invalid_credentials`: nepoznati račun, pogrešna lozinka ili račun bez lozinke.

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/403/.en: After a correct password only: `banned`, with `until` (epoch ms, `null` for a permanent ban), or `email_unverified` (an older account whose address is not confirmed yet).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/403/.text: Samo nakon točne lozinke: `banned`, s `until` (ms od Unix epohe, `null` za trajnu suspenziju), ili `email_unverified` (stariji račun čija adresa još nije potvrđena).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/429/.en: `too_many_attempts` (the failure delay of this login name), or `rate_limited` (the `auth` limit, the password hash queue).
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/429/.text: `too_many_attempts` (odgoda nakon neuspjeha za ovo ime za prijavu) ili `rate_limited` (ograničenje `auth`, red za hashiranje lozinki).

/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/503/.en: `server_busy` (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1login/post/responses/503/.text: `server_busy` (red za hashiranje lozinki ili je baza podataka ostala zaključana), `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/summary.en: Complete a sign-in with a second factor

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/descripti.en:
The second step of a sign-in with two-step verification, after `POST /auth/login` or a Google sign-in (`POST /auth/sso/google/finish` or `POST /auth/sso/google/link`) answered `mfaRequired`. Send `code` (a 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code) or `recoveryCode`. A recovery code used here is gone.

One step accepts at most 5 wrong codes; the step also ends when the password is reset or changed. After the password step of a Google link, the link is stored only when the code passes here.

**Limits:** `auth`, and at most `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) codes per 15 minutes for the account, from any address; beyond it the code is not checked, so a recovery code is not spent.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/descripti.text:
Drugi korak prijave s dvofaktorskom provjerom, nakon odgovora `mfaRequired` na `POST /auth/login` ili na prijavu putem Googlea (`POST /auth/sso/google/finish` ili `POST /auth/sso/google/link`). Pošaljite `code` (šesteroznamenkasti kod iz aplikacije za autentifikaciju ili kod za oporavak) ili `recoveryCode`. Kod za oporavak upotrijebljen ovdje nestaje.

Jedan korak prihvaća najviše 5 pogrešnih kodova; korak završava i kad se lozinka ponovno postavi ili promijeni. Nakon koraka lozinke pri povezivanju s Googleom povezivanje se sprema tek kad kod ovdje prođe.

**Ograničenja:** `auth` te najviše `AUTH_MFA_PER_ACCOUNT` (10) kodova u 15 minuta za račun, s bilo koje adrese; iznad toga kod se ne provjerava, pa se kod za oporavak ne troši.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `invalid_request`: neither `code` nor `recoveryCode` was sent, or the body breaks the schema; `invalid_json`.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `invalid_request`: nije poslan ni `code` ni `recoveryCode` ili tijelo krši shemu; `invalid_json`.

/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.en: `invalid_mfa_token`: the step expired, was used, or ended after 5 wrong codes, or the password was reset or changed since the first step (sign in again). `invalid_code`: a wrong or already used code.
/paths/~1auth~1login~1mfa/post/responses.text: `invalid_mfa_token`: korak je istekao, upotrijebljen je ili je završio nakon 5 pogrešnih kodova, ili je lozinka ponovno postavljena ili promijenjena nakon prvog koraka (ponovno se prijavite). `invalid_code`: pogrešan ili već upotrijebljen kod.
