/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en:
Sends the e-mail confirmation link again. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address, so that it never tells whether an account or a signup uses it.

A request acts at most once every 5 minutes per address. A signup waiting with that address gets its 24 hours again, whether or not another account uses the address, so that its username stays held as long in both cases. A link is sent only for that signup when the address has no account (a new link, valid 24 hours, replaces the previous one), or for an active, unconfirmed account with that address.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_mail` (10 per hour per client).
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text:
Ponovno šalje poveznicu za potvrdu adrese e-pošte. Odgovor je 202 `accepted` bez obzira na adresu, tako da nikad ne otkriva koristi li je neki račun ili registracija.

Zahtjev djeluje najviše jednom svakih 5 minuta po adresi. Registracija na čekanju s tom adresom ponovno dobiva svojih 24 sata, bez obzira na to koristi li adresu drugi račun, tako da njezino korisničko ime u oba slučaja ostaje zadržano jednako dugo. Poveznica se šalje samo za tu registraciju kad adresa nema račun (nova poveznica, valjana 24 sata, zamjenjuje prethodnu) ili za aktivni, nepotvrđeni račun s tom adresom.

**Ograničenja:** `auth`, zatim `auth_mail` (10 na sat po klijentu).

/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link of an unconfirmed account was stored (the renewal of a waiting signup is best effort and never fails the request); the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them does nothing. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text: `server_busy` s `retryAfter: 1`: baza podataka ostala je zaključana dok se tražio račun ili spremala poveznica nepotvrđenog računa (obnova registracije na čekanju izvodi se prema mogućnostima i nikad ne uzrokuje neuspjeh zahtjeva); 5 minuta za adresu ipak počinje teći, pa novi zahtjev unutar njih ne čini ništa. `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/sum.text: Slanje poveznice za ponovno postavljanje lozinke

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.en:
Sends a password reset link, valid for one hour, which opens the page `/reset-password`. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address. A link goes only to an active account, at most once every 5 minutes per address. A Google-only account sets its first password this way.

Password recovery has the strictest limits of the API, all counted for the whole server: 3 requests per hour (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) and 10 per 24 hours (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) per client (an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /64), 3 times those numbers per IPv6 /48, on top of the `auth` limit (20 per 10 minutes) and of the one mail per address every 5 minutes. Neither the 202 nor the 429 tells whether an account uses the address. Setting the new password has its own limit (`auth_reset`).

**Limits:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, then `auth_forgot_day`.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.text:
Šalje poveznicu za ponovno postavljanje lozinke, valjanu jedan sat, koja otvara stranicu `/reset-password`. Odgovor je 202 `accepted` bez obzira na adresu. Poveznica se šalje samo aktivnom računu, najviše jednom svakih 5 minuta po adresi. Račun samo s prijavom putem Googlea na ovaj način postavlja svoju prvu lozinku.

Oporavak lozinke ima najstroža ograničenja API-ja, sva brojena za cijeli poslužitelj: 3 zahtjeva na sat (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) i 10 u 24 sata (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) po klijentu (IPv4 adresa ili IPv6 /64), triput toliko po IPv6 /48, uz ograničenje `auth` (20 u 10 minuta) i jednu e-poruku po adresi svakih 5 minuta. Ni 202 ni 429 ne otkrivaju koristi li adresu neki račun. Postavljanje nove lozinke ima vlastito ograničenje (`auth_reset`).

**Ograničenja:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, zatim `auth_forgot_day`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link was stored; the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them sends no link. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.text: `server_busy` s `retryAfter: 1`: baza podataka ostala je zaključana dok se tražio račun ili spremala poveznica; 5 minuta za adresu ipak počinje teći, pa novi zahtjev unutar njih ne šalje poveznicu. `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/summ.en: Set a new password with a reset link's token
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/summ.text: Postavljanje nove lozinke tokenom iz poveznice za ponovno postavljanje

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.en:
Sets a new password with the token of a reset link (the page `/reset-password` does the same). The new password follows the rules of registration.

The reset has these effects, in one transaction (all of them, or none): it revokes every session and cancels a pending e-mail change; the other reset links of the account stop working; the address counts as confirmed (the link proved it); the owner gets a mail. Two-step verification is not touched. After a password hash queue error, a 503 or a 500, nothing changed: the old password and the sessions stay, and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (10 per hour per client, 30 per IPv6 /48, shared with the page: each attempt hashes a password).
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.text:
Postavlja novu lozinku tokenom iz poveznice za ponovno postavljanje lozinke (stranica `/reset-password` čini isto). Nova lozinka slijedi pravila registracije.

Ponovno postavljanje ima ove učinke, u jednoj transakciji (svi ili nijedan): opoziva sve sesije i otkazuje promjenu e-pošte na čekanju; ostale poveznice za ponovno postavljanje lozinke tog računa prestaju vrijediti; adresa se smatra potvrđenom (poveznica je to dokazala); vlasnik dobiva e-poruku. Dvofaktorska provjera ostaje netaknuta. Nakon pogreške reda za hashiranje lozinki, 503 ili 500, ništa se nije promijenilo: stara lozinka i sesije ostaju, a poveznica ostaje valjana.

**Ograničenja:** `auth`, zatim `auth_reset` (10 na sat po klijentu, 30 po IPv6 /48, zajedničko sa stranicom: svaki pokušaj hashira lozinku).

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: The password is changed and every session is signed out.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: Lozinka je promijenjena i sve su sesije odjavljene.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `invalid_token`: the link is invalid, used or expired, or was mailed to an address the account no longer has. `weak_password` (with `reason`). `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `invalid_token`: poveznica je nevaljana, upotrijebljena ili istekla, ili je poslana na adresu koju račun više nema. `weak_password` (s `reason`). `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `rate_limited`: the `auth` or `auth_reset` limit, or the password hash queue.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `rate_limited`: ograničenje `auth` ili `auth_reset` ili red za hashiranje lozinki.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: `server_busy`: the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked (`retryAfter: 1`, nothing changed). `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `server_busy`: red za hashiranje lozinki ili je baza podataka ostala zaključana (`retryAfter: 1`, ništa nije promijenjeno). `timeout`. Također `server_busy` s `retryAfter` od 2 do 5 kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod): zahtjev nije izvršen.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.en:
Starts a Google sign-in attempt for the PKCE challenge and the port of the game's listener on `127.0.0.1`. The answer gives the Google URL to open in the system browser and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes.

`authUrl` holds `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (built from `redirectPort` and the server's origin tag), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (S256 of the server's own verifier for Google) with `code_challenge_method=S256`, and `prompt=select_account`. The game checks it before it opens it (see the tag description).

**Limit:** `sso_start`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.text:
Pokreće pokušaj prijave putem Googlea za PKCE izazov i port slušatelja igre na `127.0.0.1`. Odgovor daje Googleov URL koji treba otvoriti u pregledniku sustava i `state` pokušaja; pokušaj vrijedi 10 minuta.

`authUrl` sadrži `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (sastavljen od `redirectPort` i oznake podrijetla poslužitelja), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (S256 vlastitog verifikatora poslužitelja za Google) s `code_challenge_method=S256` te `prompt=select_account`. Igra ga provjerava prije nego što ga otvori (vidi opis odjeljka).

**Ograničenje:** `sso_start`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/r.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava putem Googlea nije ponuđena na ovom poslužitelju.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en: Start a Google sign-in on a website
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: Pokretanje prijave putem Googlea na web-mjestu

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.en:
Starts a Google sign-in attempt of a website for the PKCE challenge of its page. The answer is the same as for the game: the Google URL to navigate to, and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes. Offered when `GET /info` says `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` holds the website's `client_id` and `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, with the same other parameters as for the game. The page checks it before it navigates to it (see **On a website** in the tag description).

**Limit:** `sso_start`, shared with the game's start.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text:
Pokreće pokušaj prijave putem Googlea s web-mjesta za PKCE izazov njegove stranice. Odgovor je isti kao za igru: Googleov URL na koji treba prijeći i `state` pokušaja; pokušaj vrijedi 10 minuta. Ponuđeno kad `GET /info` kaže `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` sadrži `client_id` web-mjesta i `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, s istim ostalim parametrima kao za igru. Stranica ga provjerava prije nego što prijeđe na njega (vidi **Na web-mjestu** u opisu odjeljka).

**Ograničenje:** `sso_start`, zajedničko s pokretanjem iz igre.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1web~1start/p.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava putem Googlea nije ponuđena na ovom poslužitelju ili nije ponuđena web-mjestima.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: Hand Google's answer to the server
A session, a second step, or the next step of a first Google sign-in.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: Sesija, drugi korak ili sljedeći korak prve prijave putem Googlea.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: Signed in to the linked account
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: Prijava u povezani račun je uspjela

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: An account with a password uses the address

`invalid_verifier`: the verifier does not match the attempt's challenge (the attempt stays usable). `sso_email_unverified`: Google has not confirmed the address. `registration_closed`. `account_disabled`. For a linked account only: `banned` (with `until`), `email_unverified`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `invalid_verifier`: verifikator ne odgovara izazovu pokušaja (pokušaj ostaje upotrebljiv). `sso_email_unverified`: Google nije potvrdio adresu. `registration_closed`. `account_disabled`. Samo za povezani račun: `banned` (s `until`), `email_unverified`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava putem Googlea nije ponuđena na ovom poslužitelju.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: `sso_account_exists`: an active account without a password uses the address (it is not named).
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.text: `sso_account_exists`: adresu koristi aktivni račun bez lozinke (ne navodi se koji).

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1finish/post/.en: `sso_expired`: an unknown, used or expired attempt.
`server_busy` (the database stayed locked), `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.en: Link Google to an existing account with its password
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.text: Povezivanje Googlea s postojećim računom pomoću njegove lozinke

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.en:
After `finish` answered `needsPassword`: links Google to the existing account with that account's password, typed in the game. The answer (200) is a session (the link is stored and the player signed in), or, when two-step verification is on, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`, and the link is stored only when a code passes there.

A wrong password leaves the ticket usable, for 5 tries in all. A try is taken just before the password is checked: a 429 `too_many_attempts` or a 428 `pow_required` takes none, while a refusal of the password hash queue (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) has taken one and counts as a failure of the account. The failure delay is the same counter as `POST /auth/login`.

**Limit:** `auth` (with its IPv6 /48 count). **Proof of work:** as for `POST /auth/login`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.text:
Nakon što je `finish` odgovorio s `needsPassword`: povezuje Google s postojećim računom pomoću lozinke tog računa, upisane u igri. Odgovor (200) je sesija (povezivanje je spremljeno i igrač je prijavljen) ili, kad je dvofaktorska provjera uključena, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: nastavite s `POST /auth/login/mfa`, a povezivanje se sprema tek kad ondje prođe kod.

Pogrešna lozinka ostavlja tiket upotrebljivim, ukupno za 5 pokušaja. Pokušaj se troši neposredno prije provjere lozinke: 429 `too_many_attempts` ili 428 `pow_required` ne troše nijedan, dok je odbijanje reda za hashiranje lozinki (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) već potrošilo jedan i broji se kao neuspjeh računa. Odgoda nakon neuspjeha isti je brojač kao kod `POST /auth/login`.

**Ograničenje:** `auth` (s brojanjem po IPv6 /48). **Dokaz rada:** kao za `POST /auth/login`.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: A session, or the second step of the sign-in.
`invalid_credentials`: a wrong password; the ticket stays, for 5 tries in all.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `invalid_credentials`: pogrešna lozinka; tiket ostaje upotrebljiv, ukupno za 5 pokušaja.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_disabled`: Google sign-in is not offered on this server.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_disabled`: prijava putem Googlea nije ponuđena na ovom poslužitelju.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_already_linked`: the Google account was linked to another account meanwhile.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_already_linked`: Google račun u međuvremenu je povezan s drugim računom.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.en: `sso_expired`: an unknown, used or expired ticket, the 5th wrong password, an account whose status or address changed since `finish`, or one whose status, address, password or two-step verification changed while the link was being stored. Start the sign-in again.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/re.text: `sso_expired`: nepoznat, upotrijebljen ili istekao tiket, peta pogrešna lozinka, račun čiji su se status ili adresa promijenili nakon `finish` ili račun čiji su se status, adresa, lozinka ili dvofaktorska provjera promijenili dok se povezivanje spremalo. Ponovno pokrenite prijavu.

Changes the password. The current password is needed, but no second factor, even with two-step verification on. The new password follows the rules of registration (checked after the current password).

/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.en:
Changes the account's e-mail address. `newEmail` is trimmed and lower-cased, then checked like a registration address.

**With e-mail confirmation** (the default): 202 `verification_sent`. A link valid for 24 hours goes to the new address; it opens `/confirm-email-change`, and the address changes only when the player presses that page's button. Until then, `GET /account/me` shows the new address as `pendingEmail`. A new request replaces the pending one; a password change or reset cancels it. At most one link goes to a given new address every 5 minutes, whoever asks (a request for the change already pending keeps the link sent earlier, which stays valid); the answer is the same. The current address gets a notice that a change to a masked address (`a***@example.org`) was requested. The answer and `pendingEmail` are the same when another account already uses the new address: no link is sent then, so that change never completes, and the owner of that address gets a notice (at most one per hour) instead.

When the link is confirmed, the address changes and counts as confirmed, the devices stay signed in, the links sent earlier (confirmation, password reset, other changes) stop working, and the former address is told, with the new one masked.

**Without e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): the address changes at once (200 `email_changed`), and the former address is told. If another account uses the address, the answer is 409 `email_taken`, and the owner of that address gets the notice.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. `invalid_email` and `same_email` are checked before the password, so they count no failure. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.text:
Mijenja adresu e-pošte računa. Iz `newEmail` uklanjaju se razmaci na početku i kraju, adresa se pretvara u mala slova, a zatim se provjerava kao adresa pri registraciji.

**S potvrdom e-pošte** (zadano): 202 `verification_sent`. Poveznica valjana 24 sata šalje se na novu adresu; otvara `/confirm-email-change`, a adresa se mijenja tek kad igrač pritisne gumb na toj stranici. Do tada `GET /account/me` prikazuje novu adresu kao `pendingEmail`. Novi zahtjev zamjenjuje onaj na čekanju; promjena ili ponovno postavljanje lozinke otkazuje ga. Na određenu novu adresu šalje se najviše jedna poveznica svakih 5 minuta, bez obzira na to tko je traži (zahtjev za promjenu koja je već na čekanju zadržava ranije poslanu poveznicu, koja ostaje valjana); odgovor je isti. Trenutna adresa dobiva obavijest da je zatražena promjena na maskiranu adresu (`a***@example.org`). Odgovor i `pendingEmail` isti su i kad neki drugi račun već koristi novu adresu: tada se ne šalje nikakva poveznica, pa se ta promjena nikad ne dovršava, a vlasnik te adrese umjesto toga dobiva obavijest (najviše jednu na sat).

Kad se poveznica potvrdi, adresa se mijenja i smatra se potvrđenom, uređaji ostaju prijavljeni, ranije poslane poveznice (potvrda, ponovno postavljanje lozinke, druge promjene) prestaju raditi, a prethodna adresa dobiva obavijest u kojoj je nova adresa maskirana.

**Bez potvrde e-pošte** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): adresa se odmah mijenja (200 `email_changed`), a prethodna adresa dobiva obavijest. Ako adresu koristi neki drugi račun, odgovor je 409 `email_taken`, a vlasnik te adrese dobiva obavijest.

**Ponovna autentifikacija:** lozinka i, uz dvofaktorsku provjeru, kod iz aplikacije ili kod za oporavak. `invalid_email` i `same_email` provjeravaju se prije lozinke, pa se ne broje kao neuspjeh. **Ograničenja:** `reauth`, zatim `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.en:
Everything the server keeps about the account, as one JSON file to save (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). The export records a security event (`account_exported`). The `notes` array of the document tells the player in plain English what is left out.

**Never in the export:** the password hash, the two-step verification secret and the recovery codes; any session or link token, or a hash of one; the anti-cheat's data (integrity level and score, anomalies, the analysis of the games, the weight of a report); the reports other players made about the player; the identities of moderators; other players' private data (opponents appear by their public name and rating, nothing tells whether another player was sanctioned, and no IP address that may be another person's is included).

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `account_export` (5 per hour per player, for the whole server; every attempt counts, failed ones included; checked first), then `reauth` and `reauth_user`. **Time limit:** 60 seconds.
/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.text:

**Nikad u izvozu:** hash lozinke, tajni ključ dvofaktorske provjere i kodovi za oporavak; bilo koji token sesije ili poveznice, kao ni njegov hash; podaci sustava protiv varanja (razina i ocjena integriteta, anomalije, analiza partija, težina prijave); prijave koje su drugi igrači podnijeli protiv igrača; identiteti moderatora; privatni podaci drugih igrača (protivnici se pojavljuju pod svojim javnim imenom i rejtingom, ništa ne otkriva je li neki drugi igrač sankcioniran i nije uključena nijedna IP adresa koja bi mogla pripadati drugoj osobi).

**Ponovna autentifikacija:** lozinka i, uz dvofaktorsku provjeru, kod iz aplikacije ili kod za oporavak. **Ograničenja:** `account_export` (5 na sat po igraču, za cijeli poslužitelj; broji se svaki pokušaj, uključujući neuspjele; provjerava se prvo), zatim `reauth` i `reauth_user`. **Vremensko ograničenje:** 60 sekundi.

/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.en:
Deletes the account; this cannot be undone.

- Every session is revoked at once: the token gets 401 `invalid_token` from then on.
- The user name becomes `deleted#<id>`, in the account and in every game record.
- These are erased: the e-mail address, the password hash, the two-step secret and recovery codes, the sessions and link tokens, the Google link, the anti-cheat's integrity record, and the IP addresses stored with security events.
- Ratings and games are kept. Games stay readable under the anonymous name, and `GET /players/{username}` answers 404 for the former name.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.text:
Briše račun; to se ne može poništiti.

- Sve se sesije odmah opozivaju: token od tada dobiva 401 `invalid_token`.
- Korisničko ime postaje `deleted#<id>`, u računu i u svakom zapisu partije.
- Brišu se: adresa e-pošte, hash lozinke, tajni ključ dvofaktorske provjere i kodovi za oporavak, sesije i tokeni poveznica, povezivanje s Googleom, zapis integriteta iz sustava protiv varanja te IP adrese spremljene uz sigurnosne događaje.
- Rejtinzi i partije zadržavaju se. Partije ostaju čitljive pod anonimnim imenom, a `GET /players/{username}` za prijašnje ime odgovara s 404.

**Ponovna autentifikacija:** lozinka i, uz dvofaktorsku provjeru, kod iz aplikacije ili kod za oporavak. **Ograničenja:** `reauth`, zatim `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/summary.en: Download a game as a PGN file

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.en:
The same game as a PGN file: one game with `\n` line endings, and move text in lines under 80 columns. The answer is the same with or without a token.

Tags, in this order: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` or `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (the UTC start date), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` for an aborted game), `UTCDate` and `UTCTime` (the start), `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` (the ratings at the start, or `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` and `BlackRatingDiff` (the changes, such as `+10` and `-10`, in every rated game, `+0` when the rating rules leave the rating where it was; a casual, custom or aborted game has neither), `TimeControl` (in seconds), `Termination` (a PGN standard value: `normal`; `time forfeit`, a flag fall, also when it ends in a draw; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, a second illegal move or a fair-play forfeit; `unterminated`, an aborted game), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (the decimal id).

Each move carries `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: the mover's clock after the move and the time charged for it, in tenths of a second (truncated). A value is left out when the record lacks it. After the last move, the end reason follows in words, then the result.

**Limit:** `public_read` (per player with a token, per client without).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.text:
Ista partija kao PGN datoteka: jedna partija sa završecima redaka `\n` i tekstom poteza u recima kraćima od 80 stupaca. Odgovor je isti s tokenom i bez njega.

Oznake, ovim redoslijedom: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` ili `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (datum početka u UTC-u), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` za poništenu partiju), `UTCDate` i `UTCTime` (početak), `WhiteElo` i `BlackElo` (rejtinzi na početku ili `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` i `BlackRatingDiff` (promjene, primjerice `+10` i `-10`, u svakoj partiji za rejting, `+0` kad pravila rejtinga ostave rejting nepromijenjenim; partija bez rejtinga, s prilagođenim tempom igre ili poništena partija nema ni jednu ni drugu), `TimeControl` (u sekundama), `Termination` (standardna vrijednost PGN-a: `normal`; `time forfeit`, istek vremena, i kad završi remijem; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, drugi nepravilan potez ili kontumacija zbog kršenja pravila poštene igre; `unterminated`, poništena partija), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (decimalni ID).

Svaki potez nosi `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: sat igrača koji je odigrao potez, nakon tog poteza, i vrijeme obračunato za potez, u desetinkama sekunde (odsječeno). Vrijednost se izostavlja kad je zapis nema. Nakon posljednjeg poteza slijedi razlog završetka riječima, zatim rezultat.

**Ograničenje:** `public_read` (po igraču s tokenom, po klijentu bez tokena).

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/descriptio.en:
The game as an animated GIF. The names and ratings are those of the game record (the ratings at the start, a deleted account as `deleted#<id>`), and so are the result and the ending (`Resignation`, `Loss on time`...).

The checks come in this order: `gif_disabled`, the picture options (`size`, `orientation`, `delay`, `coords`), the game id, the game, its length.

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** `gif` on every request; `gif_user_min`, `gif_user_hour`, `gif_ip_min` and `gif_ip_hour` only when the GIF has to be made (see the tag description). **Time limit:** `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` + `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` + 5 seconds (45 seconds by default).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/descriptio.text:
Partija kao animirani GIF. Imena i rejtinzi preuzimaju se iz zapisa partije (rejtinzi na početku, izbrisani račun kao `deleted#<id>`), kao i rezultat i način završetka (`Resignation`, `Loss on time`...).

Provjere se obavljaju ovim redoslijedom: `gif_disabled`, mogućnosti slike (`size`, `orientation`, `delay`, `coords`), ID partije, partija, njezina duljina.

**Potrebna sesija:** kvote se broje po računu. **Ograničenja:** `gif` na svakom zahtjevu; `gif_user_min`, `gif_user_hour`, `gif_ip_min` i `gif_ip_hour` samo kad GIF treba izraditi (vidi opis odjeljka). **Vremensko ograničenje:** `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` + `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` + 5 sekundi (prema zadanim postavkama 45 sekundi).

/paths/~1gif/post/summary.en: Make an animated GIF of any game sent as PGN
/paths/~1gif/post/summary.text: Izrada animiranog GIF-a bilo koje partije poslane kao PGN

/paths/~1gif/post/description.en:
The same picture as `GET /games/{id}/gif` for any game sent as PGN text: a game saved by the game, an export of another site, a game typed by hand. Only the first game of the text is used.

- The PGN reader takes what the game's own reader takes: every PGN that this server writes and the usual exports of other sites (comments, variations, NAGs and clock annotations are skipped; move numbers and SAN read leniently; a `FEN` tag gives the start position unless `SetUp` is `"0"`).
- The names and ratings come from the `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` tags. Accented letters lose their accents, other characters outside printable ASCII become `?`, and long names are cut (48 characters). The result comes from the `Result` tag, else from the end of the move text. The `Termination` tag is shown unless it is `normal`: the final position then tells the story (checkmate, stalemate).
- This endpoint checks its body itself: an unknown field or a missing or non-string `pgn` answers 400 `invalid_request` with `field`; a wrong option answers 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` must be a JSON number, `coords` a boolean; `null` is refused).

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** as for `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Body limit:** 135,168 bytes, whatever `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (the PGN as a JSON string, its escapes included). **Time limit:** 45 seconds by default.
/paths/~1gif/post/description.text:
Ista slika kao kod `GET /games/{id}/gif` za bilo koju partiju poslanu kao PGN tekst: partiju koju je spremila igra, izvoz s nekog drugog web-mjesta, partiju upisanu ručno. Koristi se samo prva partija iz teksta.

- Čitač PGN-a prihvaća ono što prihvaća i vlastiti čitač igre: svaki PGN koji ovaj poslužitelj zapisuje i uobičajene izvoze drugih web-mjesta (komentari, varijante, NAG-ovi i bilješke sata preskaču se; brojevi poteza i SAN čitaju se tolerantno; oznaka `FEN` daje početnu poziciju osim ako je `SetUp` `"0"`).
- Imena i rejtinzi uzimaju se iz oznaka `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` i `BlackElo`. Slova s dijakritičkim znakovima gube ih, ostali znakovi izvan ispisivog ASCII-ja postaju `?`, a duga se imena skraćuju (48 znakova). Rezultat se uzima iz oznake `Result`, inače s kraja teksta poteza. Oznaka `Termination` prikazuje se osim ako je `normal`: završna pozicija tada sama govori kako je partija završila (mat, pat).
- Ova krajnja točka sama provjerava svoje tijelo: na nepoznato polje ili na `pgn` koji nedostaje ili nije niz znakova odgovara s 400 `invalid_request` s `field`; na pogrešnu mogućnost odgovara s 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` mora biti JSON broj, `coords` logička vrijednost; `null` se odbija).

**Potrebna sesija:** kvote se broje po računu. **Ograničenja:** kao za `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Ograničenje veličine tijela:** 135.168 bajtova, bez obzira na `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (PGN kao JSON niz znakova, uključujući njegove escape sekvence). **Vremensko ograničenje:** prema zadanim postavkama 45 sekundi.

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/summary.en: Get the top players of a category

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/description.en:
The top 100 rated records of an official category with at least `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) counted games, deleted accounts and confirmed cheaters left out. The server computes each board again at most every 10 seconds; `updatedAt` says when. One computation of a category runs at a time: meanwhile the other requests get the previous list, or wait for the computation when there is none yet.

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.

Poslužitelj svaku ljestvicu ponovno izračunava najviše svakih 10 sekundi; `updatedAt` kaže kada. Za jednu kategoriju istodobno se izvodi samo jedan izračun: u međuvremenu ostali zahtjevi dobivaju prethodni popis ili čekaju izračun ako popisa još nema.

/paths/~1reports/post/summary.en: Report the opponent of a recent game

/paths/~1reports/post/description.en:
Reports the opponent of one of the player's own games that ended within the last 7 days. A report never changes a rating, a sanction or an integrity level by itself. It raises the review priority that moderators see, and, except for `abuse`, it asks for the engine analysis of the game.

A report of the same opponent for the same game gets the same answer and changes nothing; the answer never tells anything about the reported account. `GET /games/{id}` tells the game's players beforehand whether a report would be taken (`reportable`).

This endpoint checks its body itself, in the order `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: a failure answers 400 `invalid_request` without `field`. Fields it does not know are ignored.

**Limits:** `reports` (per player), then `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) reports per player in 24 hours (429 `report_limit`).
/paths/~1reports/post/description.text:
Prijavljuje protivnika iz jedne od igračevih vlastitih partija koja je završila u posljednjih 7 dana. Prijava sama po sebi nikad ne mijenja rejting, sankciju ni razinu integriteta. Podiže prioritet pregleda koji vide moderatori i, osim za `abuse`, traži analizu partije šahovskim programom.

Prijava istog protivnika za istu partiju dobiva isti odgovor i ništa ne mijenja; odgovor nikad ništa ne otkriva o računu protiv kojeg je podnesena prijava. `GET /games/{id}` igračima partije unaprijed govori bi li prijava bila prihvaćena (`reportable`).

Ova krajnja točka sama provjerava svoje tijelo, redoslijedom `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: na neuspjeh odgovara s 400 `invalid_request` bez `field`. Polja koja ne poznaje zanemaruju se.

**Ograničenja:** `reports` (po igraču), zatim `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) prijava po igraču u 24 sata (429 `report_limit`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/summary.text: Postavljanje nove lozinke iz obrasca za ponovno postavljanje

/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.en:
The form of the reset page; it does what `POST /auth/password/reset` does, in one transaction: every device is signed out, a pending e-mail change is cancelled, the other reset links stop working, the address counts as confirmed and the owner gets a mail.

The link is checked first, then that both passwords are the same, then the password rules. When the server is busy, the form comes back with `Retry-After` and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (shared with `POST /auth/password/reset`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.text:
Obrazac stranice za ponovno postavljanje; radi isto što i `POST /auth/password/reset`, u jednoj transakciji: svi se uređaji odjavljuju, promjena e-pošte na čekanju otkazuje se, ostale poveznice za ponovno postavljanje prestaju raditi, adresa se smatra potvrđenom, a vlasnik dobiva e-poruku.

Najprije se provjerava poveznica, zatim jesu li obje lozinke iste, a zatim pravila za lozinku. Kad je poslužitelj zauzet, obrazac se vraća s `Retry-After`, a poveznica ostaje valjana.

**Ograničenja:** `auth`, zatim `auth_reset` (zajedničko s `POST /auth/password/reset`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/2.text: Lozinka je promijenjena, a svi su uređaji odjavljeni.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.en: The form again with the error (the passwords differ, a weak password), the link is invalid, or the form is invalid (an HTML page).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.text: Ponovno obrazac s pogreškom (lozinke se razlikuju, slaba lozinka), poveznica nije valjana ili obrazac nije valjan (HTML stranica).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.en: The `auth` or `auth_reset` limit (an HTML page), the form again with `Retry-After` when this client has too many password hashes waiting (the link stays valid), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.text: Ograničenje `auth` ili `auth_reset` (HTML stranica), ponovno obrazac s `Retry-After` kad ovaj klijent ima previše hashiranja lozinki na čekanju (poveznica ostaje valjana) ili sloj po adresi (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/5.en: The form again with `Retry-After` when the server is busy (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked); the link stays valid. When the server is far behind (see the introduction), a "Server error" page with `Retry-After` (2 to 5) instead: nothing was run and the link stays valid. Also the handler timeout.
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/5.text: Ponovno obrazac s `Retry-After` kad je poslužitelj zauzet (red za hashiranje lozinki ili je baza podataka ostala zaključana); poveznica ostaje valjana. Kad poslužitelj jako kasni (vidi uvod), umjesto toga stranica „Server error“ (pogreška poslužitelja) s `Retry-After` (od 2 do 5): ništa nije izvršeno i poveznica ostaje valjana. Također istek vremena za obradu zahtjeva.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/servers/0/.en: The official server (pages live at the root, outside `/api/v1`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/servers/0/.text: Službeni poslužitelj (stranice se nalaze u korijenu, izvan `/api/v1`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/servers/1/.en: Any Scacelith server (pages live at the root, outside `/api/v1`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/servers/1/.text: Bilo koji poslužitelj Scacelith (stranice se nalaze u korijenu, izvan `/api/v1`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/summar.en: Show the e-mail change confirmation page
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/summar.text: Prikaz stranice za potvrdu promjene e-pošte

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/descri.en:
The page of an e-mail change link: it shows the new address and the account's name, with a "Use this e-mail address" button that posts the form to `POST /confirm-email-change`.

**Limit:** `page`.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/descri.text:
Stranica poveznice za promjenu e-pošte: prikazuje novu adresu i ime računa, s gumbom „Use this e-mail address“ (Koristi ovu adresu e-pošte) koji šalje obrazac na `POST /confirm-email-change`.

**Ograničenje:** `page`.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The page with the new address and its confirmation button.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Stranica s novom adresom i gumbom za njezinu potvrdu.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The link is invalid or expired (also when the account's address changed since the request).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Poveznica nije valjana ili je istekla (i kad se adresa računa promijenila nakon zahtjeva).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.en: The `page` limit (an HTML page), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/get/respon.text: Ograničenje `page` (HTML stranica) ili sloj po adresi (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/descr.en:
The form of the e-mail change page. The address changes and counts as confirmed; the devices stay signed in; the links sent earlier (confirmation, password reset, other changes) stop working; the former address is told, with the new one masked.

**Limit:** `auth`.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/descr.text:
Obrazac stranice za promjenu e-pošte. Adresa se mijenja i smatra se potvrđenom; uređaji ostaju prijavljeni; ranije poslane poveznice (potvrda, ponovno postavljanje lozinke, druge promjene) prestaju raditi; prethodna adresa dobiva obavijest u kojoj je nova adresa maskirana.

**Ograničenje:** `auth`.

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The link is invalid, used or expired, or the form is invalid (an HTML page).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Poveznica nije valjana, već je upotrijebljena ili je istekla, ili obrazac nije valjan (HTML stranica).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: Another account took the address in the meantime (an HTML page).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Drugi je račun u međuvremenu zauzeo adresu (HTML stranica).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The `auth` limit (an HTML page), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Ograničenje `auth` (HTML stranica) ili sloj po adresi (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.en: The database stayed locked (`Retry-After: 1`), or the server is far behind (`Retry-After` 2 to 5, see the introduction): nothing changed and the link still works. Also the handler timeout.
/paths/~1confirm-email-change/post/respo.text: Baza podataka ostala je zaključana (`Retry-After: 1`) ili poslužitelj jako kasni (`Retry-After` od 2 do 5, vidi uvod): ništa nije promijenjeno i poveznica i dalje radi. Također istek vremena za obradu zahtjeva.

/paths/~1healthz/servers/0/description.en: The official server, at the root.

/paths/~1healthz/servers/2/description.en: Any Scacelith server, at the root.
/paths/~1healthz/servers/2/description.text: Bilo koji poslužitelj Scacelith, u korijenu.

/paths/~1healthz/get/description.en:
Answers 200 `ok` while the process runs. `HEAD` works too. Any other method answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` (`OPTIONS` included).

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1healthz/get/description.text:
Odgovara s 200 `ok` dok proces radi. Radi i `HEAD`. Svaka druga metoda dobiva odgovor 405 `method_not_allowed` s `Allow: GET, HEAD` (uključujući `OPTIONS`).

**Ograničenja:** samo sloj po adresi.

/paths/~1readyz/servers/0/description.en: The official server, at the root.

/paths/~1readyz/servers/2/description.en: Any Scacelith server, at the root.
/paths/~1readyz/servers/2/description.text: Bilo koji poslužitelj Scacelith, u korijenu.

/paths/~1readyz/get/summary.en: Check that the server accepts players

/paths/~1readyz/get/description.en:
Answers 200 `ready` when the server accepts players, and 503 `not_ready` while it starts or stops. `HEAD` works too. Any other method answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` (`OPTIONS` included).

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1readyz/get/description.text:
Odgovara s 200 `ready` kad poslužitelj prihvaća igrače i s 503 `not_ready` dok se pokreće ili zaustavlja. Radi i `HEAD`. Svaka druga metoda dobiva odgovor 405 `method_not_allowed` s `Allow: GET, HEAD` (uključujući `OPTIONS`).

**Ograničenja:** samo sloj po adresi.

/paths/~1readyz/get/responses/503/descri.en: The server is starting or stopping.

/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.en: A session token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) from a sign-in answer, in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The prefix is exactly `Bearer` (case-sensitive) and one space; a value that does not have it, or a token that is not 1 to 512 printable ASCII characters, answers 401 `invalid_token` like any other invalid token. An empty header counts as no header.
/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.text: Token sesije (`sct_` iza kojeg slijede 43 base64url znaka) iz odgovora na prijavu, u zaglavlju `Authorization`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Prefiks je točno `Bearer` (razlikuju se velika i mala slova) i jedan razmak; vrijednost koja ga nema ili token koji nema od 1 do 512 ispisivih ASCII znakova dobiva odgovor 401 `invalid_token` kao i svaki drugi nevaljani token. Prazno zaglavlje smatra se nepostojećim zaglavljem.

/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.en: The game id, a positive decimal integer of at most 16 digits without leading zeros, below 2^53.
/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.text: ID partije, pozitivan decimalni cijeli broj od najviše 16 znamenki bez vodećih nula, manji od 2^53.

/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.en: The session id, as `GET /auth/sessions` gives it, written without leading zeros (`03` is not session 3).
/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.text: ID sesije, onako kako ga daje `GET /auth/sessions`, napisan bez vodećih nula (`03` nije sesija 3).

/components/parameters/Username/descript.en: The player's user name, without regard to case. The server takes any name that is 2 to 24 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (the widest rule it ever allowed).
/components/parameters/Username/descript.text: Korisničko ime igrača, bez obzira na velika i mala slova. Poslužitelj prihvaća svako ime od 2 do 24 znaka iz `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (najšire pravilo koje je ikad dopuštao).

/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.en: A game id; only older games are listed. Pass the previous page's `next`. An empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.text: ID partije; navode se samo starije partije. Pošaljite `next` prethodne stranice. Prazna vrijednost smatra se izostavljenom.

/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.en: The page size, 1 to 50. A larger number of up to 3 digits counts as 50; an empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.text: Veličina stranice, od 1 do 50. Veći broj od najviše 3 znamenke smatra se brojem 50; prazna vrijednost smatra se izostavljenom.

/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.en: The token of the e-mail link (43 base64url characters). A missing or wrong one shows the "link invalid or expired" page.
/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.text: Token poveznice iz e-poruke (43 base64url znaka). Ako nedostaje ili je pogrešan, prikazuje se stranica „link invalid or expired“ (poveznica nije valjana ili je istekla).

/components/headers/CacheControl/descrip.en: Every answer of the server forbids caching.
/components/headers/CacheControl/descrip.text: Svaki odgovor poslužitelja zabranjuje spremanje u predmemoriju.

/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.en: Seconds to wait before trying again; the same value as `retryAfter` in the body.
/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.text: Broj sekundi čekanja prije ponovnog pokušaja; ista vrijednost kao `retryAfter` u tijelu.

/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.en: The bearer challenge, with `error="invalid_token"` for an invalid token.
/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.text: Izazov sheme bearer, s `error="invalid_token"` za nevaljani token.

/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.en: The server closes the connection after this answer.
/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.text: Poslužitelj zatvara vezu nakon ovog odgovora.

/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.en: `invalid_request` (with `field` when a field of the body is at fault) or `invalid_json`.
/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.text: `invalid_request` (s `field` kad je problem u nekom polju tijela) ili `invalid_json`.

/components/responses/BadRequest/content.en: A PGN that cannot be read
/components/responses/BadRequest/content.text: PGN koji se ne može pročitati

/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.en: `unauthorized` (no `Authorization` header) or `invalid_token` (the token is malformed, expired, revoked, or belongs to a deleted account).
/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.text: `unauthorized` (nema zaglavlja `Authorization`) ili `invalid_token` (token je neispravnog oblika, istekao, opozvan ili pripada izbrisanom računu).

/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.en: `not_found`, or a feature that this server turned off.
/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.text: `not_found` ili značajka koju je ovaj poslužitelj isključio.

/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.en: `request_timeout`: the body did not arrive within 10 seconds. The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.text: `request_timeout`: tijelo nije stiglo u roku od 10 sekundi. Poslužitelj zatvara vezu.

/components/responses/Conflict/descripti.en: The request conflicts with the state of the server.
/components/responses/Conflict/descripti.text: Zahtjev je u sukobu sa stanjem poslužitelja.

/components/responses/Gone/description.en: `sso_expired`: the Google sign-in attempt or ticket is unknown, used or expired; start the sign-in again.
/components/responses/Gone/description.text: `sso_expired`: pokušaj prijave putem Googlea ili tiket nepoznat je, upotrijebljen ili istekao; ponovno pokrenite prijavu.

/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.en: `payload_too_large`: the body exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (16,384 bytes by default). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.text: `payload_too_large`: tijelo premašuje `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (prema zadanim postavkama 16.384 bajta). Poslužitelj zatvara vezu.

/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.en: `unsupported_media_type`: the body is not `application/json`, or its charset is not UTF-8.
/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.text: `unsupported_media_type`: tijelo nije `application/json` ili njegov skup znakova nije UTF-8.

/components/responses/UnprocessableConte.en: `game_too_long`: the game has more than `GIF_MAX_PLIES` (600) half-moves.

/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.en: `pow_required`: solve the `pow` challenge and send the same request again with `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` says why: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.
/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.text: `pow_required`: riješite izazov `pow` i ponovno pošaljite isti zahtjev s `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` kaže zašto: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` ili `replayed`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.en: `rate_limited` (a rate limit, the account budget, or the password hash queue) or `too_many_attempts` (a throttle of the account), with `retryAfter` and a `Retry-After` header.
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.text: `rate_limited` (ograničenje učestalosti, kvota računa ili red za hashiranje lozinki) ili `too_many_attempts` (ograničenje na razini računa), s `retryAfter` i zaglavljem `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.en: Too many failures on this account

/components/responses/InternalError/desc.en: `internal_error`: an unexpected failure. The server logs it.
/components/responses/InternalError/desc.text: `internal_error`: neočekivana pogreška. Poslužitelj je bilježi u dnevnik.

/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.en: `sso_failed`: a wrong `state` or `iss`, or Google refused the code or sent an ID token that does not verify (a code or ID token of the other client, the game's or the website's, included). It never carries Google's text.
/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.text: `sso_failed`: pogrešan `state` ili `iss`, ili je Google odbio kod ili poslao ID token koji ne prolazi provjeru (uključujući kod ili ID token drugog klijenta, igre ili web-mjesta). Nikad ne sadrži Googleov tekst.

/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.en: `server_busy`, `busy` or `timeout`: try again after `retryAfter` when it is given.
/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.text: `server_busy`, `busy` ili `timeout`: pokušajte ponovno nakon `retryAfter` kad je naveden.

/components/responses/GifFile/descriptio.en: The animated GIF, as an attachment.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` for a game of this server, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` for a PGN sent with `POST /gif`.
/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.text: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` za partiju s ovog poslužitelja, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` za PGN poslan s `POST /gif`.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: The size of the file in bytes.

/components/responses/HtmlBadRequest/des.en: An HTML page that explains the refusal.

/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.en: The form did not arrive within 10 seconds (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.text: Obrazac nije stigao u roku od 10 sekundi (HTML stranica). Poslužitelj zatvara vezu.

/components/responses/HtmlConflict/descr.en: An HTML page that explains the conflict.

/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.en: The form exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.text: Obrazac premašuje `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (HTML stranica). Poslužitelj zatvara vezu.

/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.en: The body is neither a form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) nor JSON, or its charset is not UTF-8 (an HTML page).
/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.text: Tijelo nije ni obrazac (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) ni JSON ili njegov skup znakova nije UTF-8 (HTML stranica).

/components/responses/HtmlTooManyRequest.en: A rate limit (an HTML page), with `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.en: An unexpected failure (an HTML page titled "Server error"). The server logs it.
/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.text: Neočekivana pogreška (HTML stranica s naslovom „Server error“, tj. pogreška poslužitelja). Poslužitelj je bilježi u dnevnik.

/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.en: The server is busy (the database stayed locked, or the server is far behind; with `Retry-After`) or took too long (an HTML page titled "Server error").
/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.text: Poslužitelj je zauzet (baza podataka ostala je zaključana ili poslužitelj jako kasni; s `Retry-After`) ili je predugo odgovarao (HTML stranica s naslovom „Server error“, tj. pogreška poslužitelja).

/components/schemas/Error/description.en: The one shape of every error answer of the JSON API.
/components/schemas/Error/description.text: Jedinstveni oblik svakog odgovora s pogreškom u JSON API-ju.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.en: The `snake_case` error code. A client chooses what to show from it.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.text: Kod pogreške u obliku `snake_case`. Na temelju njega klijent odabire što će prikazati.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.en: An English sentence, meant for logs and as a fallback.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.text: Rečenica na engleskom, namijenjena dnevnicima i kao zamjenski tekst.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.en: Seconds to wait before trying again, present only on refusals that end with time. The answer then also carries a `Retry-After` header with the same value, except the 503 `busy` of the history, game, player and leaderboard reads.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.text: Broj sekundi čekanja prije ponovnog pokušaja, prisutan samo kod odbijanja koja s vremenom prestaju. Odgovor tada nosi i zaglavlje `Retry-After` s istom vrijednošću, osim kod 503 `busy` pri čitanju povijesti, partija, igrača i ljestvice.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.en: The field or query parameter at fault (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option`, and `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` and `invalid_filter` of `GET /account/games`). A nested field is dotted (`pow.nonce`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.text: Polje ili parametar upita u kojem je problem (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option` te `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` i `invalid_filter` kod `GET /account/games`). Ugniježđeno polje piše se s točkom (`pow.nonce`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.en: Why: the rule a `weak_password` breaks, or why a proof of work was asked for or refused (`pow_required`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.text: Razlog: pravilo koje `weak_password` krši ili zašto je dokaz rada zatražen ili odbijen (`pow_required`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.en: `banned` only: the end of the ban (epoch ms), `null` for a permanent ban.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.text: Samo `banned`: kraj suspenzije (ms od Unix epohe), `null` za trajnu suspenziju.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/lin.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the line of the error, from 1.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/col.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the column of the error, from 1, in characters.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/col.text: Samo `invalid_pgn`: stupac pogreške, od 1, u znakovima.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The signed challenge, to send back as it is.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Potpisani izazov, koji treba vratiti nepromijenjen.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The number of leading zero bits that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` must have.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Broj vodećih nultih bitova koje `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` mora imati.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: When the challenge expires (epoch ms), 2 minutes after it was issued.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Kad izazov istječe (ms od Unix epohe), 2 minute nakon izdavanja.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/descriptio.en: The answer to a proof-of-work challenge.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.en: The `challenge` of the 428 answer, as it was given.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.text: `challenge` iz odgovora 428, onako kako je dan.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.en: A decimal string of at most 20 digits such that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` starts with `bits` zero bits.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.text: Decimalni niz od najviše 20 znamenki takav da `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` počinje s `bits` nultih bitova.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.en: What a client needs before it signs in or connects.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.text: Ono što klijentu treba prije nego što se prijavi ili poveže.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The server's name (`SERVER_NAME`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Naziv poslužitelja (`SERVER_NAME`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: A UUID that the database gets on its first start. It stays the same across restarts. It is `null` when the database cannot give it.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: UUID koji baza podataka dobiva pri prvom pokretanju. Ostaje isti nakon ponovnih pokretanja. Ima vrijednost `null` kad ga baza podataka ne može dati.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The message of the day (`SERVER_MOTD`), possibly empty.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Poruka dana (`SERVER_MOTD`), moguće prazna.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The WebSocket protocol (`PROTOCOL.md`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Protokol WebSocketa (`PROTOCOL.md`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The oldest protocol version the server speaks.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Najstarija verzija protokola koju poslužitelj podržava.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The newest protocol version the server speaks.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Najnovija verzija protokola koju poslužitelj podržava.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The fingerprint of the protocol schema (first 4 bytes of the SHA-256 of its canonical form, as an unsigned integer: `0xc649140f`, 3326678031, for protocol minor 2); informational, never compared.

/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.en:
A security event. `ip` is given only for what was done while signed in, with the account's password (and second factor) or with a link mailed to its address: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` and `account_exported`; every other kind has `ip: null`, and `ip` is erased after `RETENTION_IP_DAYS`.

`detail` keeps only these fields: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` and `method` (`password`, or `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` and `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. A `moderator_action` event keeps only `{ action }`, for the actions `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` and `revoke_sessions` (the other moderator actions are left out). Every other kind has `detail: null`. The `rating_refund` events are left out: their points are in `ratingRefunds`.
/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.text:
Sigurnosni događaj. `ip` se navodi samo za ono što je učinjeno u prijavljenom stanju, lozinkom računa (i drugim faktorom) ili poveznicom poslanom na njegovu adresu: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` i `account_exported`; svaka druga vrsta ima `ip: null`, a `ip` se briše nakon `RETENTION_IP_DAYS` dana.

`detail` zadržava samo ova polja: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` i `method` (`password` ili `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` i `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. Događaj `moderator_action` zadržava samo `{ action }`, za radnje `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` i `revoke_sessions` (ostale radnje moderatora izostavljaju se). Svaka druga vrsta ima `detail: null`. Događaji `rating_refund` izostavljaju se: njihovi su bodovi u `ratingRefunds`.
